StandardExpressions.proof:
/- Definition 4.9, printed p. 17:
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=17
https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-def-standard-expressions-artin-tits-normalisers
The portal definition has an unnumbered Justification, not numbered proof
steps. We implement its composability, product, and length-additivity
conditions directly. The factor count is List.length es; existence and
independence are subsequent assertions.

The defect report's finding pdf-wall-root-characterisation concerns the
auxiliary inclusion after (3.15), printed p. 10: in rank one with I empty,
v sends the positive simple root to its negative, while the printed target
Phi_K^- is empty. See
https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
Disposition: use the retained longest-element SimpleWallCrossings definition;
that rejected auxiliary characterization is not used. No statement defect
is reported for Definition 4.9. Rank and Coxeter type remain unrestricted;
only each crossing component is required to have a finite parabolic.
-/
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J I K w =>
  let Obj := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun L a =>
    { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
  let Atom := { p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.1.val p.2)) }
  let crossing := fun e : Atom => SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
  -- The fold threads each target into the next source, ending at K.
  -- For [], it requires I.val = K.val; the product and sum are 1 and 0.
  { es : List Atom //
    List.foldr
      (fun e tail L => L = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing e).2.1)
      (fun L => L = K.val) es I.val ∧
    List.prod (List.map (fun e => (crossing e).1) es) = w.val ∧
    CoxeterSystem.length cs w.val =
      List.sum (List.map (fun e => CoxeterSystem.length cs (crossing e).1) es) }

/- Source: Notation 3.13 and (3.14)-(3.15), article p. 10;
   opposition convention: Notation 2.5 and (2.6), p. 5.
   https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-def-simple-wall-crossing-artin-tits-normalisers
   The portal definition has an unnumbered Justification: there are no numbered
   proof steps to cite. This construction follows that justification.

   Translation limitation, not a literature defect: the supplied codomain
   contains raw data without a specification of opposition. Accordingly,
   epsilon below uses the exact negative-simple-root predicate, but this term
   does not prove that predicate. Inhabitedness of D ≃ D is not used as evidence
   for it. Its specification requires finite-parabolic opposition; chamber
   preservation and adjacency likewise remain separate assertions.

   Read this portal definition, its longest-element definition, and article
   pp. 5 and 10; consulted both supplied investigation reports. No complete
   transitive-source reading is claimed. Fresh GitHub/mathlib search located
   Finite.exists_max; actual use is from the pinned local revision.
   This expression compiled under import ArtinDeligne with Lean 4.36.0-rc2.
   Axiom audit: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. -/
fun S W _inst M cs I a _ha =>
  let D : Set S := {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}
  fun hD =>
    letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D) := hD
    /- The unnumbered Justification uses W_L ≤ W_D. Its inclusion preserves
       the ambient element, so Subtype.ext proves injectivity. A subgroup
       contains 1, providing the nonemptiness needed by Finite.exists_max.
       Thus the selected witness maximizes ambient length on W_L. -/
    let longest : (L : Set S) → L ⊆ D → W := fun L hL =>
      letI : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) :=
        Finite.of_injective
          (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L =>
            (⟨(w : W), (CoxeterSystem.parabolic_mono cs hL) w.property⟩ :
              CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D))
          (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext
            (congrArg (fun z : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs D => (z : W)) h))
      (Classical.choose (Finite.exists_max
        (fun w : CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L =>
          CoxeterSystem.length cs (w : W)))).val
    let wD := longest D (fun _ h => h)
    /- Exact predicate from (2.6). Equiv.refl supplies only inhabitedness;
       no opposition specification is inferred from it. -/
    let opposition : Equiv D D :=
      @Classical.epsilon (Equiv D D) ⟨Equiv.refl D⟩
        (fun e => ∀ i : D,
          CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs wD
            (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : Real)) =
              -Finsupp.single (e i : S) (1 : Real))
    /- The zero-edge path puts a in its component. The hypothesis a ∉ I
       remains in the requested type; forming raw data needs no further use.
       Only W_D is assumed finite, with no rank or ambient-type restriction. -/
    let aD : D := ⟨a, ⟨Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩⟩
    let v := longest (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset * wD
    let K : Set S := Set.insert a I \ {(opposition aD : S)}
    (v, K, fun x => (x * v, K))

```lean
import RecoveredPrerequisites
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
noncomputable section

/- New local helpers for Lemma 4.15/(4.16), printed p.19.
Portal inspiration: rank-two-standard-words steps 1.1, 2.1 and
TwoGeneratorMinimal steps 1.1, 2.1. No standalone article attribution. -/
namespace CorankTwoContinuation
section Generic
variable {A O W : Type*} [Group W] {S : Type*} {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (value : A → W)

def product (es : List A) : W := (es.map value).prod
def weight (es : List A) : Nat := (es.map (fun e => cs.length (value e))).sum

theorem weight_bound (es : List A) : cs.length (product value es) ≤ weight cs value es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp [product, weight]
  | cons e es ih =>
    exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _) 

theorem tail_additive (e : A) (es : List A)
    (h : cs.length (product value (e :: es)) = weight cs value (e :: es)) :
    cs.length (product value es) = weight cs value es := by
  have hb := weight_bound cs value es
  have hm := cs.length_mul_le (value e) (product value es)
  change cs.length (value e * product value es) = cs.length (value e) + weight cs value es at h
  omega

theorem no_inverse_head (e f : A) (es : List A)
    (hp : 0 < cs.length (value e))
    (h : cs.length (product value (e :: f :: es)) = weight cs value (e :: f :: es)) :
    value e * value f ≠ 1 := by
  intro hinv
  have hb := weight_bound cs value es
  have heq : product value (e :: f :: es) = product value es := by
    change value e * (value f * product value es) = product value es
    rw [← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
  rw [heq] at h
  change cs.length (product value es) =
    cs.length (value e) + (cs.length (value f) + weight cs value es) at h
  omega

variable (src tgt : A → O) (allowed : A → Prop)

def Walk (p : A) (es : List A) : Prop :=
  es.foldr (fun e tail prev => allowed e ∧ src e = tgt prev ∧
    value prev * value e ≠ 1 ∧ tail e) (fun _ => True) p

theorem next_unique
    (hTwo : ∀ e f r : A, allowed e → allowed f → allowed r →
      src e = src f → src e = src r → e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r)
    (hRev : ∀ p : A, allowed p → ∃ r : A,
      allowed r ∧ src r = tgt p ∧ value p * value r = 1)
    {p e f : A} (hp : allowed p) (he : allowed e) (hf : allowed f)
    (hse : src e = tgt p) (hsf : src f = tgt p)
    (hne : value p * value e ≠ 1) (hnf : value p * value f ≠ 1) : e = f := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsr, hinv⟩ := hRev p hp
  rcases hTwo e f r he hf hr (hse.trans hsf.symm) (hse.trans hsr.symm) with h | h | h
  · exact h
  · subst e; exact False.elim (hne hinv)
  · subst f; exact False.elim (hnf hinv)

theorem continuation_unique
    (hTwo : ∀ e f r : A, allowed e → allowed f → allowed r →
      src e = src f → src e = src r → e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r)
    (hRev : ∀ p : A, allowed p → ∃ r : A,
      allowed r ∧ src r = tgt p ∧ value p * value r = 1)
    (es fs : List A) (p : A) (hp : allowed p)
    (he : Walk value src tgt allowed p es) (hf : Walk value src tgt allowed p fs)
    (hlen : es.length = fs.length) : es = fs := by
  induction es generalizing fs p with
  | nil => cases fs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons f fs => simp at hlen
  | cons e es ih =>
    cases fs with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons f fs =>
      have hef : e = f := next_unique value src tgt allowed hTwo hRev hp
        he.1 hf.1 he.2.1 hf.2.1 he.2.2.1 hf.2.2.1
      subst f
      exact congrArg (List.cons e) (ih fs e he.1 he.2.2.2 hf.2.2.2 (by simpa using hlen))

/-- Read the concrete foldr composability predicate without constructing suffix arrows. -/
theorem standard_walk (es : List A) (L K : O)
    (hc : es.foldr (fun e tail N => N = src e ∧ tail (tgt e))
      (fun N => N = K) L)
    (ha : ∀ e ∈ es, allowed e)
    (hp : ∀ e : A, allowed e → 0 < cs.length (value e))
    (hadd : cs.length (product value es) = weight cs value es) :
    ∀ p tail, es = p :: tail → Walk value src tgt allowed p tail := by
  induction es generalizing L with
  | nil => intro p tail h; cases h
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro p tail h
    cases h
    cases es with
    | nil => trivial
    | cons f fs =>
      refine ⟨ha f (by simp), hc.2.1.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact no_inverse_head cs value e f fs (hp e (ha e (by simp))) hadd
      · exact ih (tgt e) hc.2 (fun a h => ha a (by simp [h]))
          (tail_additive cs value e (f :: fs) hadd) f fs rfl
end Generic

section Concrete
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)

abbrev Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J}
def component (L : Set S) (c : S) : Set S :=
  {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d}
abbrev Atom := {p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧
  Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) p.1.val p.2))}
def crossing (e : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
abbrev src (e : Atom cs J) : Set S := e.val.1.val
abbrev tgt (e : Atom cs J) : Set S := (crossing cs J e).2.1
abbrev value (e : Atom cs J) : W := (crossing cs J e).1

def InResidue (T : Set S) (e : Atom cs J) : Prop :=
  src cs J e ⊆ T ∧ e.val.2 ∈ T ∧
  ∃ c d : S, c ≠ d ∧ T \ src cs J e = {c, d}

theorem atom_ext {e f : Atom cs J} (hs : src cs J e = src cs J f)
    (hi : e.val.2 = f.val.2) : e = f := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hs) hi

theorem residue_missing {T : Set S} {e : Atom cs J} (he : InResidue cs J T e)
    {c d : S} (hcd : T \ src cs J e = {c, d}) : e.val.2 = c ∨ e.val.2 = d := by
  have h : e.val.2 ∈ T \ src cs J e := ⟨he.2.1, e.property.1⟩
  rw [hcd] at h
  simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h

theorem two_outgoing (T : Set S) (e f r : Atom cs J)
    (he : InResidue cs J T e) (hf : InResidue cs J T f) (hr : InResidue cs J T r)
    (hsf : src cs J e = src cs J f) (hsr : src cs J e = src cs J r) :
    e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hne, hcd⟩ := he.2.2
  have hfcd : T \ src cs J f = {c,d} := hsf ▸ hcd
  have hrcd : T \ src cs J r = {c,d} := hsr ▸ hcd
  rcases residue_missing cs J he hcd with hec | hed <;>
    rcases residue_missing cs J hf hfcd with hfc | hfd <;>
    rcases residue_missing cs J hr hrcd with hrc | hrd
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hec.trans hfc.symm))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hec.trans hfc.symm))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsr (hec.trans hrc.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (atom_ext cs J (hsf.symm.trans hsr) (hfd.trans hrd.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (atom_ext cs J (hsf.symm.trans hsr) (hfc.trans hrc.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsr (hed.trans hrd.symm)))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hed.trans hfd.symm))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hed.trans hfd.symm))

theorem standard_same_first (T : Set S)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J T r ∧ src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1)
    {I K : Obj cs J} {q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K}
    (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K q)
    (he : ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (hf : ∀ p ∈ f.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (p : Atom cs J) (es fs : List (Atom cs J))
    (hes : e.val = p :: es) (hfs : f.val = p :: fs) : e = f := by
  have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q e f
  have headd : cs.length (product (value cs J) e.val) = weight cs (value cs J) e.val := by
    rw [show product (value cs J) e.val = q.val from e.property.2.1]
    exact e.property.2.2
  have hfadd : cs.length (product (value cs J) f.val) = weight cs (value cs J) f.val := by
    rw [show product (value cs J) f.val = q.val from f.property.2.1]
    exact f.property.2.2
  have hewalk := standard_walk cs (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) e.val I.val K.val e.property.1 he hPos headd p es hes
  have hfwalk := standard_walk cs (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) f.val I.val K.val f.property.1 hf hPos hfadd p fs hfs
  have hp := he p (by rw [hes]; exact List.mem_cons_self)
  have hlen : es.length = fs.length := by rw [hes, hfs] at hcount; exact Nat.succ.inj hcount
  have htail := continuation_unique (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) (two_outgoing cs J T) hRev es fs p hp hewalk hfwalk hlen
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hes, hfs, htail]

/-- Construct a standard word with the specified atom, using an additive prefix. -/
theorem standard_with_first_of_prefix (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) (a : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hprefix : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD).1⁻¹ * q.val)) :
    ∃ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∃ es, e.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hD⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es := by
  let c := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD
  obtain ⟨hL, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J I.val I.property a ha hD
  let L : Obj cs J := ⟨c.2.1, hL⟩
  let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K :=
    (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv f) q
  have hz : z.val = c.1⁻¹ * q.val := by change f.val⁻¹ * q.val = _; rw [hf]
  obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J L K z).1
  let p : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hD⟩⟩
  let e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q := by
    refine ⟨p :: ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨rfl, ez.property.1⟩
    · change c.1 * (ez.val.map (value cs J)).prod = q.val
      rw [show (ez.val.map (value cs J)).prod = z.val from ez.property.2.1, hz]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
    · change cs.length q.val = cs.length c.1 +
        (ez.val.map (fun e => cs.length (value cs J e))).sum
      rw [← show cs.length z.val =
        (ez.val.map (fun e => cs.length (value cs J e))).sum from ez.property.2.2, hz]
      exact hprefix
  exact ⟨e, ez.val, rfl⟩

/-- Conditional classification. The confinement, positivity and reverse inputs
are explicit; this theorem does not prove them. -/
theorem rank_two_standard_words_of_residue
    (T : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J) (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val b)))
    (hMissing : T \ I.val = {a,b})
    (hConf : ∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J T r ∧ src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1)
    (ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q)
    (hstarta : ∃ es, ea.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es)
    (hstartb : ∃ es, eb.val = (⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) :
    ea ≠ eb ∧ (∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = ea ∨ e = eb) ∧
      ea.val.length = eb.val.length := by
  let pa : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩
  let pb : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨as, has⟩ := hstarta
  obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ := hstartb
  have hne : ea ≠ eb := by
    intro h
    have hh : pa :: as = pb :: bs := has.symm.trans ((congrArg Subtype.val h).trans hbs)
    have hatom : pa = pb := (List.cons.inj hh).1
    exact hab (congrArg (fun p : Atom cs J => p.val.2) hatom)
  refine ⟨hne, ?_, (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q ea eb⟩
  intro e
  have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q e ea
  cases hes : e.val with
  | nil => rw [hes, has] at hcount; simp at hcount
  | cons p es =>
    have hcomp := e.property.1
    change e.val.foldr (fun p tail N => N = src cs J p ∧ tail (tgt cs J p))
      (fun N => N = K.val) I.val at hcomp
    rw [hes] at hcomp
    have hsrc : src cs J p = I.val := hcomp.1.symm
    have hp := hConf e p (by rw [hes]; exact List.mem_cons_self)
    have hi : p.val.2 ∈ T \ I.val := ⟨hp.2.1, hsrc ▸ p.property.1⟩
    rw [hMissing] at hi
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hi with hia | hib
    · have hpa : p = pa := atom_ext cs J hsrc hia
      have hep : e.val = pa :: es := by rw [hes, hpa]; rfl
      exact Or.inl (standard_same_first cs J T hPos hRev e ea
        (hConf e) (hConf ea) pa es as hep has)
    · have hpb : p = pb := atom_ext cs J hsrc (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hib)
      have hep : e.val = pb :: es := by rw [hes, hpb]; rfl
      exact Or.inr (standard_same_first cs J T hPos hRev e eb
        (hConf e) (hConf eb) pb es bs hep hbs)

/-- Complete assembly from the two additive prefixes and the three residue inputs.
No exactly-two word assertion is assumed. The finite-relative-root hypothesis is
used by the caller to establish the inputs, not silently added to an ambient type. -/
theorem rank_two_of_prefixes (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val b)))
    (hpa : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1⁻¹ * q.val))
    (hpb : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1⁻¹ * q.val))
    (hConf : ∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) r ∧
      src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1) :
    ∃ ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ea ≠ eb ∧ (∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = ea ∨ e = eb) ∧
      ea.val.length = eb.val.length ∧
      (∃ es, ea.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) ∧
      (∃ es, eb.val = (⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) := by
  obtain ⟨ea, hsa⟩ := standard_with_first_of_prefix cs J I K q a ha hDa hpa
  obtain ⟨eb, hsb⟩ := standard_with_first_of_prefix cs J I K q b hb hDb hpb
  have hMissing : (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ I.val = {a,b} := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hc, hn⟩
      rcases hc with rfl | rfl | hc
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
      · exact False.elim (hn hc)
    · intro hc
      rcases hc with rfl | hc
      · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, ha⟩
      · have hcb : c = b := hc
        subst c
        exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), hb⟩
  obtain ⟨hne, honly, hlen⟩ := rank_two_standard_words_of_residue cs J
    (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) I K q a b ha hb hab hDa hDb
    hMissing hConf hPos hRev ea eb hsa hsb
  exact ⟨ea, eb, hne, honly, hlen, hsa, hsb⟩
end Concrete
end CorankTwoContinuation
```

import ArtinDeligne
import Proofs.StandardFactorCount
import Proofs.GeneratorsAndStandardLength

namespace PrescribedFirstWords

abbrev Obj {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  {L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom
    (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J}

def component {S : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (L : Set S) (c : S) : Set S :=
  {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d}

abbrev Atom {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  {p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component M p.1.val p.2))}

-- Local implementation helper for Lemma 4.15/(4.16), printed p.19.
-- It is not a separately stated article result.
theorem firstWord {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (c : S) (hc : c ∉ I.val) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I.val c)))
    (hp : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val c hc hD).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val c hc hD).1⁻¹ * q.val)) :
    ∃ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∃ tail : List (Atom cs J), e.val = ⟨(I,c), ⟨hc,hD⟩⟩ :: tail := by
  classical
  let v := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val c hc hD
  obtain ⟨hC, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J I.val I.property c hc hD
  let C : Obj cs J := ⟨v.2.1, hC⟩
  let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom C K :=
    (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv f) q
  have hz : z.val = v.1⁻¹ * q.val := by
    change f.val⁻¹ * q.val = _
    rw [hf]
  obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J C K z).1
  let atom : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,c), ⟨hc,hD⟩⟩
  refine ⟨⟨atom :: ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ez.val, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨rfl, ez.property.1⟩
  · change v.1 * List.prod (List.map _ ez.val) = q.val
    rw [ez.property.2.1, hz]
    exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
  · change cs.length q.val = cs.length v.1 + List.sum (List.map _ ez.val)
    rw [← ez.property.2.2, hz]
    exact hp

-- Independent prescribed initial words; no rank-two classification is used.
theorem twoFirstWords {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I.val a)))
    (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I.val b)))
    (hpa : cs.length q.val = cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1⁻¹ * q.val))
    (hpb : cs.length q.val = cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1⁻¹ * q.val)) :
    ∃ ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ea ≠ eb ∧ ea.val.length = eb.val.length ∧
      (∃ ta : List (Atom cs J), ea.val = ⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ :: ta) ∧
      (∃ tb : List (Atom cs J), eb.val = ⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ :: tb) := by
  obtain ⟨ea, ta, hta⟩ := firstWord cs J I K q a ha hDa hpa
  obtain ⟨eb, tb, htb⟩ := firstWord cs J I K q b hb hDb hpb
  refine ⟨ea, eb, ?_, (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q ea eb,
    ⟨ta,hta⟩, ⟨tb,htb⟩⟩
  intro heq
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val heq
  rw [hta, htb] at h
  exact hab (congrArg (fun e : Atom cs J => e.val.2) (List.cons.inj h).1)

-- Sufficient exhaustion boundary; does not assert this missing boundary.
theorem exhaustive_of_atMostTwo {E : Type*} (ea eb : E) (hne : ea ≠ eb)
    (h : ∀ x y z : E, x = y ∨ x = z ∨ y = z) :
    ∀ e : E, e = ea ∨ e = eb := by
  intro e
  rcases h e ea eb with he | he | he
  · exact Or.inl he
  · exact Or.inr he
  · exact False.elim (hne he)

-- Uniqueness from inversion data uses the arbitrary-rank weak-order theorem.
theorem labelEqOfInverseSigns {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (x y : W)
    (h : ∀ α ∈ cs.geometricRoots, 0 < α →
      (cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ α < 0 ↔ cs.geometricRepresentation y⁻¹ α < 0)) :
    x = y := by
  have hxy := (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_iff_rootInversions_subset_system cs x y).mpr
    (fun α hr hp hn => (h α hr hp).mp hn)
  have hyx := (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_iff_rootInversions_subset_system cs y x).mpr
    (fun α hr hp hn => (h α hr hp).mpr hn)
  have hz : cs.length (x⁻¹ * y) = 0 := by omega
  exact inv_mul_eq_one.mp (cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hz)

noncomputable def N {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (x : W) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α} ∩
    cs.geometricRepresentation x '' {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ α < 0}

theorem labelEqOfN {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (x y : W) (h : N cs x = N cs y) : x = y := by
  have memN (w : W) (α : S →₀ ℝ) : α ∈ N cs w ↔
      α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ α < 0 := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hp, β, hn, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2, by simpa only [Representation.inv_self_apply] using hn.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hr,hp⟩, cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ α,
        ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).mpr hr, hn⟩,
        Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩
  apply labelEqOfInverseSigns cs x y
  intro α hr hp
  constructor
  · intro hn
    exact ((memN y α).mp (h ▸ (memN x α).mpr ⟨hr,hp,hn⟩)).2.2
  · intro hn
    exact ((memN x α).mp (h.symm ▸ (memN y α).mpr ⟨hr,hp,hn⟩)).2.2

-- Equal labels with fixed source determine the target object, including its tag.
theorem targetEqOfLabelEq {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (I K L : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (r : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L) (hqr : q.val = r.val) : K = L := by
  let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  have he : cs.geometricRepresentation q.val '' (root '' K.val) =
      cs.geometricRepresentation q.val '' (root '' L.val) := by
    calc
      _ = root '' I.val := q.property
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation r.val '' (root '' L.val) := r.property.symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hqr]
  have hp := congrArg (Set.image (cs.geometricRepresentation q.val⁻¹)) he
  simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply] at hp
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hm : root i ∈ root '' L.val := hp ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem root hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := hm
    have hij : j = i := Finsupp.single_left_injective (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) heq
    exact hij ▸ hj
  · intro hi
    have hm : root i ∈ root '' K.val := hp.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem root hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := hm
    have hij : j = i := Finsupp.single_left_injective (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) heq
    exact hij ▸ hj

-- Transport retains every source tag and index: the entire list is unchanged.
theorem transportWord {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (I K L : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (r : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L) (hqr : q.val = r.val)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q) :
    ∃ f : StandardExpressions cs J I L r, f.val = e.val := by
  have hKL := targetEqOfLabelEq cs J I K L q r hqr
  subst L
  have hq : q = r := Subtype.ext hqr
  subst r
  exact ⟨e, rfl⟩

-- This transfers a proved canonical classification; it does not prove one.
theorem atMostTwoTransport {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (I K L : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (r : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I L) (hN : N cs q.val = N cs r.val)
    (h : ∀ e f g : StandardExpressions cs J I L r, e = f ∨ e = g ∨ f = g) :
    ∀ e f g : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = f ∨ e = g ∨ f = g := by
  have hqr := labelEqOfN cs q.val r.val hN
  have hKL := targetEqOfLabelEq cs J I K L q r hqr
  subst L
  have heq : q = r := Subtype.ext hqr
  subst r
  exact h

#print axioms targetEqOfLabelEq
#print axioms transportWord
#print axioms atMostTwoTransport

```lean
import ArtinDeligne


noncomputable def RelativeCone : (∀ {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S), let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J; let V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Vector S; Set Θ × Set Θ × Set V × Set V × Set V × Set (Submodule Real Θ)) :=
(fun {S} _ M J =>
  let Θ := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.relativeSubspace J
  let V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Vector S
  letI : TopologicalSpace Θ :=
    TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
  let titsCone : Set (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S) :=
    { f | ∃ (w : CoxeterMatrix.Group M) (g : ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.Dual S),
        ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.IsDominant g ∧
        ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.dualAction M w g = f }
  let cone : Set Θ := { f | f.val ∈ titsCone }
  let relativeRoots : Set V := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots M J
  let positiveRelativeRoots : Set V := { r | r ∈ relativeRoots ∧ 0 < r }
  let negativeRelativeRoots : Set V := { r | r ∈ relativeRoots ∧ r < 0 }
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) :=
    Set.image (ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.restrictedHyperplane J) positiveRelativeRoots
  (cone, interior cone, relativeRoots, positiveRelativeRoots, negativeRelativeRoots, arrangement))

open ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18 ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3

-- Local implementation for portal step 2.1:
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-normaliser-chamber-action-artin-tits-normalisers
-- Parent: article Lemmas 3.23--3.24, printed p. 12. No standalone
-- article statement is attributed to the local have blocks below.
theorem wallTransport {S : Type*} [Finite S] (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let Θ := relativeSubspace J
    letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
    let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
    let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
      Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
    let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
      Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
        F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
    ∀ g : CoxeterNormalizer M J,
      let T := normalizerFlatEquiv M J g
      (∀ C F : Set Θ, wall C F → wall (T '' C) (T '' F)) ∧
      (∀ {Label : Type*} (region : Label → Set Θ) (σ : Label → Label),
        (∀ p, T '' region p = region (σ p)) →
        ∀ p q, (region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F) →
          region (σ p) ≠ region (σ q) ∧
            ∃ F, wall (region (σ p)) F ∧ wall (region (σ q)) F) := by
  classical
  let Θ := relativeSubspace J
  have htop : TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real)) =
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace Θ) := by
    exact induced_compose.symm
  dsimp only
  rw [htop]
  let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
  let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
    Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
  let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
    Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
      F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
  change ∀ g : CoxeterNormalizer M J, _
  intro g
  let T := normalizerFlatEquiv M J g
  -- Pairing gives transport of the actual restricted evaluation kernels.
  have hkernel (r : Vector S) :
      (restrictedHyperplane J r).map T.toLinearMap =
        restrictedHyperplane J (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      change (dualAction M g.val x.val)
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) = 0
      rw [dualAction_pairing]
      exact hx
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨T.symm y, ?_, T.apply_symm_apply y⟩
      have hp := dualAction_pairing M g.val (T.symm y).val r
      change (T (T.symm y)).val
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) = (T.symm y).val r at hp
      rw [T.apply_symm_apply] at hp
      exact hp.symm.trans hy
  have hnegKernel (r : Vector S) : restrictedHyperplane J (-r) =
      restrictedHyperplane J r := by
    ext f
    change f.val (-r) = 0 ↔ f.val r = 0
    rw [map_neg, neg_eq_zero]
  -- The endpoint arrangement uses positive retained roots. Transported roots
  -- need not be positive: use the root-sign dichotomy and equal opposite kernels.
  have harrangement (H : Submodule Real Θ) (hH : H ∈ arrangement) :
      H.map T.toLinearMap ∈ arrangement := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hH
    have hs := geometricAction_mem_retainedRoots M J g hr.1
    have hsroot : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r ∈
        M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := hs.1
    rw [hkernel]
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hsroot with hpos | hneg
    · exact ⟨_, ⟨hs, hpos⟩, rfl⟩
    · have hns : -(M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation g.val r) ∈
          retainedRoots M J := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · exact M.toCoxeterSystem.neg_mem_geometricRoots_iff.mpr hsroot
        · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hs.2
          exact ⟨f, by simpa only [map_neg, neg_ne_zero] using hf⟩
      exact ⟨_, ⟨hns, neg_pos.mpr hneg⟩, hnegKernel _⟩
  have hdimension (C : Set Θ) : affineDimension (T '' C) = affineDimension C := by
    change Module.finrank Real (affineSpan Real (T '' C)).direction = _
    let f : Θ →ᵃ[Real] Θ := (T.toLinearMap : Θ →ₗ[Real] Θ).toAffineMap
    change Module.finrank Real (affineSpan Real (f '' C)).direction = _
    rw [← AffineSubspace.map_span f, AffineSubspace.map_direction]
    exact T.toLinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq _
  -- General wall-image argument, kept local rather than a prerequisite item.
  have hwallImage (C F : Set Θ) (hF : wall C F) : wall (T '' C) (T '' F) := by
    obtain ⟨hne, H, hH, hFH, hdim⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨hne.image T, H.map T.toLinearMap, harrangement H hH, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change T '' F = closure (T '' C) ∩ T '' (H : Set Θ)
      rw [hFH, Set.image_inter T.injective, T.image_closure]
    · rw [hdimension, hdimension]
      exact hdim
  refine ⟨hwallImage, ?_⟩
  intro Label region σ hcov p q hpq
  obtain ⟨hne, F, hp, hq⟩ := hpq
  refine ⟨?_, T '' F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro heq
    apply hne
    apply T.injective.image_injective
    rw [hcov, hcov, heq]
  · rw [← hcov]
    exact hwallImage _ _ hp
  · rw [← hcov]
    exact hwallImage _ _ hq

#print axioms wallTransport

-- Integration check for any normalizer-quotient label action with region covariance.
-- This wrapper is only a replay harness; no new prerequisite item is requested.
theorem quotientAdjacencyFromCovariance {S : Type*} [Finite S]
    (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let Θ := relativeSubspace J
    letI : TopologicalSpace Θ := TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun f : Θ => dualCoordinates f.val)
      (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace (S → Real))
    let arrangement : Set (Submodule Real Θ) := (RelativeCone M J).2.2.2.2.2
    let affineDimension : Set Θ → Nat := fun C =>
      Module.finrank Real (AffineSubspace.direction (affineSpan Real C))
    let wall : Set Θ → Set Θ → Prop := fun C F =>
      Set.Nonempty F ∧ ∃ H : Submodule Real Θ, H ∈ arrangement ∧
        F = closure C ∩ (H : Set Θ) ∧ affineDimension F + 1 = affineDimension C
    ∀ {Label : Type*} (region : Label → Set Θ)
      (action : ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J →* Equiv.Perm Label),
      (∀ n p, quotientRepresentation M J n '' region p = region (action n p)) →
      ∀ n p q,
        (region p ≠ region q ∧ ∃ F, wall (region p) F ∧ wall (region q) F) →
        region (action n p) ≠ region (action n q) ∧
          ∃ F, wall (region (action n p)) F ∧ wall (region (action n q)) F := by
  dsimp only
  intro Label region action hcov n p q hpq
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) n
  have hrep : ⇑(quotientRepresentation M J
      (QuotientGroup.mk' ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf
        (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) g)) = ⇑(normalizerFlatEquiv M J g) := by
    funext x
    exact quotientRepresentation_mk M J g x
  apply (wallTransport M J g).2 region (action _) _ p q hpq
  intro r
  rw [← hrep]
  exact hcov _ r

#print axioms quotientAdjacencyFromCovariance
```

```lean
have nca_crossing_equivariance :
    ∀ (action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label),
      (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
        let y := action (quotientMap g) p
        y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧
        CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
        ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.val.2 ∧
          y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) →
      ∀ (adjacent : Label → Label → Prop) (n : N) (p q : Label), adjacent p q →
      ∀ (a : S) (ha : a ∉ p.val.2)
        (hD : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component p.val.2 a))),
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 p.val.1 = q.val →
        (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD).2.2 (action n p).val.1 =
          (action n q).val := by
  intro action hrep adjacent n p q _ a ha hD hpq
  have coset_iff_conj (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
      (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
      Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext z
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
          ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
        rw [← h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
        simpa [this] using hu
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
          change x * u = z * x at he
          calc
            x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
            _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
            _ = u := by group
        simpa [this] using hu
    · intro h
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        change u ∈ P at hu
        rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
        exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

  have conj_product (P : Subgroup W) (x y : W) :
      P.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom =
        (P.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun f : W →* W => P.map f)
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    change (x*y)*z*(x*y)⁻¹ = x*(y*z*y⁻¹)*x⁻¹
    group
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm) n
  let c := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs p.val.2 a ha hD
  have hq1 : q.val.1 = p.val.1 * c.1 := (congrArg Prod.fst hpq).symm
  have hq2 : q.val.2 = c.2.1 := (congrArg Prod.snd hpq).symm
  have hpconj := (coset_iff_conj (cs.parabolic J) (cs.parabolic p.val.2) p.val.1).mp p.property.1
  have hqconj := (coset_iff_conj (cs.parabolic J) (cs.parabolic q.val.2) q.val.1).mp q.property.1
  have hI : ∃ w : W, (cs.parabolic p.val.2).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      cs.parabolic J := ⟨p.val.1, hpconj⟩
  obtain ⟨hK, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J p.val.2 hI a ha hD
  have hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation c.1 ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' c.2.1) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 := by
    have h := f.property
    change cs.geometricRepresentation f.val ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' c.2.1) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 at h
    rwa [hf] at h
  have hconj : (cs.parabolic c.2.1).map (MulAut.conj c.1).toMonoidHom =
      cs.parabolic p.val.2 := by
    apply Subgroup.map_injective (f := (MulAut.conj p.val.1).toMonoidHom)
      (MulAut.conj p.val.1).injective
    rw [← conj_product, ← hq2, ← hq1, hqconj, hpconj]
  obtain ⟨_, hymin, u, hu, hy⟩ := hrep g p
  obtain ⟨hz2, hzmin, t, ht, hz⟩ := hrep g q
  have hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep c.2.1
      ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1) := by
    apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation c.1 (Finsupp.single k (1 : Real)) ∈
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' p.val.2 :=
      hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
    have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation (action (quotientMap g) p).val.1
        (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) :=
      (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff _ i).mpr
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hymin i hi)
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff _ k).mp
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos
  have hw : c.1⁻¹ * u * c.1 ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by
    rw [← hconj, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
    exact hu
  have htK : t ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by simpa only [hq2] using ht
  have hdiff : ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1)⁻¹ *
      (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 ∈ cs.parabolic c.2.1 := by
    have hmem := (cs.parabolic c.2.1).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic c.2.1).inv_mem hw) htK
    convert hmem using 1; rw [hy, hz, hq1]; group
  have hzminK : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep c.2.1 (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 := by
    simpa only [hq2] using hzmin
  have heq : (action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1 =
      (action (quotientMap g) q).val.1 :=
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs hmin hzminK hdiff
  change ((action (quotientMap g) p).val.1 * c.1, c.2.1) = (action (quotientMap g) q).val
  exact Prod.ext heq (hz2.trans hq2).symm
```

RelativeCommonWall has a viable route using existing imports and local coordinate lemmas. No additional Coxeter-theoretic supplier is presently justified. This is proof advice, not a completed or compiled Lean proof.

Endpoint inspected: the exact RelativeCommonWall submission in theorems13-14/evidence/proof-main-677bd694-87b2-4a95-83e3-9b290fe30296.json. Its conclusions concern the two unique indices describing the specified closed wall F and equality of the enlarged subsets. Preserve [Finite S], arbitrary Coxeter type, arbitrary J, and the explicit induced coordinate topology. The relevant correction is finding pdf-adjacency-uniqueness-wording at https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects: uniqueness must describe the specified common wall; enlarged-subset equality alone does not characterize the indices. Finite rank remains explicit user direction, not a correction attributed to that finding.

Numbered inspiration: common-facet steps 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1 at https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-author-4ac39e6f1702-common-facet. The parent result is Proposition 3.17, printed p.11, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=11. These references motivate the organization below; no individual numbered step is translated or certified.

First build the two full-flat coordinate charts. The coset equality in label x I implies x W_I x⁻¹ = W_J. Rewrite with ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq and construct RawFacetLabel M J with indices I and representative x. Then facetFlatEquiv supplies Θ_I ≃L[Real] Θ_J. Its declaration actually requires neither finite rank nor finite Coxeter group. mem_translatedFacet_iff identifies the submitted region x I with translatedFacet. The submitted face is definitionally standardFacet after unfolding dualCoordinates. Repeat for y,K. This avoids separately proving |I|=|J|. Reconcile the explicit topology with the imported subtype topology using induced_compose.symm, as already done in Proofs/ChamberLabelling.lean. All subsequent closures must remain in Θ_J.

The substantive missing local implementation is closed-orthant wall classification, including its affine-dimension calculation. Neither convex_translatedFacet nor the imported intersection declarations provide this conclusion. Use the chart followed by coordinates outside I, identifying Θ_I with functions {i // i ∉ I} → Real. Establish that the closure of the strictly positive orthant is the nonnegative orthant. More generally, the closure of region x L, for I ⊆ L, imposes zero coordinates on L and nonnegative coordinates elsewhere. closure_pi_set, closure_Ioi and ContinuousLinearEquiv.image_closure supply the topological infrastructure; the extension-by-zero coordinate equivalence and its restrictions still need local construction.

For the H witnessing wall (region x I) F, choose its retained-root representative r. Pull its defining functional back through x. By dualAction_apply this evaluates α = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ r. Root stability and pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots allow replacing α by -α so that all coefficients are nonnegative. Retainedness and the full-flat equivalence guarantee that some coefficient outside I is positive. Let A be the nonempty set of such indices. On the nonnegative orthant, the equation Σ α_i q_i = 0 is exactly q_i = 0 for every i ∈ A. Thus the pulled-back F is a coordinate face with precisely A forced to vanish.

Calculate affine dimensions using the submitted definition, rather than silently substituting linear-span dimension. The open orthant has full affine span: the all-ones point and its translates by coordinate basis vectors have all coordinate basis vectors as differences. The closed coordinate face contains zero and each remaining coordinate basis vector, so its affine-span direction is exactly their span. Consequently dim(F) + |A| = dim(region x I). The submitted wall equation dim(F) + 1 = dim(region x I) forces |A| = 1. Its sole element a gives F = closure (region x (insert a I)). For uniqueness, if c outside I differs from a, the coordinate basis vector at c belongs to the a-face closure and fails the equation defining the c-face closure. Apply the same argument to y,K to obtain a′ and its specified-wall uniqueness. The zero-dimensional case is excluded by the wall dimension equation itself.

For equality insert a I = insert a′ K, avoid adding a relative-interior theorem. Choose p in region x (insert a I) and q in region y (insert a′ K), using standardFacet_nonempty and the charts. Both belong to F. In each chart every point of F has nonnegative coordinates and its distinguished coordinate zero. Therefore p+q belongs to both open enlarged faces: the contribution from p makes every required x-coordinate positive, while the contribution from q does the same for y. Write p+q = x f = y g with f and g in the respective standard facets. Then dualAction M (x⁻¹*y) g = f. Apply standardFacet_translate_indices_eq, or dominant_translate_eq followed by standardFacet_indices_unique, to obtain insert a′ K = insert a I. This uses no sphericality assumption and also covers a zero-dimensional wall.

Applicability boundary: translatedFacet_intersection_indices_coset, translatedFacet_eq_of_intersection and translatedFacet_eq_iff classify intersections of full translated facets represented by RawFacetLabel M J. They confirm that the dominant-orbit uniqueness machinery already exists. They cannot directly be applied to the enlarged wall faces: those faces do not come with parabolic conjugacy to W_J and have smaller dimension. Apply standardFacet_translate_indices_eq directly to the common point instead. Also, convex_translatedFacet proves convexity, not the closure formula or classification of codimension-one boundary faces.

The required local orthant classification and dimension transport are substantial unfinished Lean work; no inspected declaration supplies them wholesale. They are local implementation helpers for RelativeCommonWall and Proposition 3.17, not independently attributed article lemmas. Their source attribution should retain that parent page and the common-facet portal URL. Do not assume RelativeCommonWall, AdjacentWallFormula, or the portal stratification theorem as an unproved shortcut.

```lean
by
  classical
  intro S W _ _ M cs J
  /-
  Proposition 4.6(1)-(2), printed p.16:
  https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=16
  Numbered proof inspiration: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 and 2.1 at
  https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-prop-chambers-morphisms-artin-tits-normalisers.
  Checked applicability: cs is the given Coxeter system; the two labels supply
  the exact coset equality and minimality; w.property supplies the root-set
  equality. No spherical-type hypothesis is used. label_roots implements 1.1;
  root_conjugacy implements 1.2 by form preservation and faithfulness;
  c_literal_label_preserved uses the simple-root right-descent criterion for
  1.3/2.1. The unique upstairs arrow is constructed only after its target label.
  The defect finding pdf-prop46-left-descent-typo is handled by the imported
  minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter theorem, which proves the correctly
  oriented inverse minimality with isRightDescent_inv_iff and isLeftDescent_iff.
  No statement change or individual numbered-step translation/review is made.
  These local implementation blocks have no original standalone statement;
  attribution is only to the parent Proposition 4.6 and portal entry above.
  Their checked code is adapted from the completed FiniteWallPaths report
  proof-main-2de1c5b7-23a7-48e1-8e2f-23218607ca73.json, not assumed as a premise.
  -/
  let Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J}
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) ∧
    cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x
  let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  let piRoots : Set S → Set (S →₀ ℝ) := fun L => root '' L
  have coset_conj (x : W) (I : Set S)
      (h : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W)) :
      (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, huv⟩
      change x * u * x⁻¹ = v at huv
      have hm : x * u ∈ (fun t : W => t * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
        h.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun t : W => x * t) hu
      obtain ⟨t, ht, he⟩ := hm
      have hev : t = v := by rw [← huv, ← he]; group
      exact hev ▸ ht
    · intro hv
      have hm : v * x ∈ (fun t : W => x * t) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) :=
        h ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun t : W => t * x) hv
      obtain ⟨t, ht, he⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
      change x * t = v * x at he
      change x * t * x⁻¹ = v
      rw [he]
      group
  have transporter_root (x : W) (I F : Set S)
      (hc : (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F)
      (hm : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x) {i : S} (hi : i ∈ I) :
      ∃ j ∈ F, cs.geometricRepresentation x (root i) = root j := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_conjugates_simple cs hc hm hi
    let v := cs.geometricRepresentation x (root i)
    have hneg : M.geometricReflection j v = -v := by
      have hprod : cs.simple j * x = x * cs.simple i := by rw [← he]; group
      calc
        _ = cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple j * x) (root i) := by
          rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
        _ = -v := by
          rw [hprod, cs.geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_single]
    have hr : v ∈ cs.geometricRoots := ⟨x, i, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 < v := (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr
      (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hm i hi)
    have hs : ∀ k, k ≠ j → v k = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have hh := congrArg (fun z : S →₀ ℝ => z k) hneg
      rw [M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hk] at hh
      change v k = -v k at hh
      linarith
    rcases cs.eq_single_or_eq_neg_single_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hs with hh | hh
    · exact ⟨j, hj, hh⟩
    · have hn : v j = -1 := by rw [hh]; simp
      have hp := hpos.le j
      change 0 ≤ v j at hp
      linarith
  have label_roots (x : W) (I : Set S) (hx : label x I) :
      cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I = piRoots J := by
    have hc := coset_conj x I hx.1
    have hci := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hc
    have hmi := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter cs hc hx.2
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := transporter_root x I J hc hx.2 hi
      exact ⟨j, hj, he.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := transporter_root x⁻¹ J I hci hmi hj
      refine ⟨root i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [← he, Representation.self_inv_apply]

  have root_conjugacy (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
      (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
      (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
    classical
    let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
    let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
    have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
        g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
      apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
        calc
          _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
            (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
          _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
      change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
      dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
      simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
        M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
        obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]

  have c_literal_label_preserved {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I K : Set S) (x v : W)
      (hcos : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W))
      (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x)
      (hconj : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic I)
      (hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation v ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' K) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I) :
      (fun u : W => u * (x * v)) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => (x * v) * u) '' (cs.parabolic K : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K (x * v) := by
    constructor
    · ext r
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have hji : j * x ∈ (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) := hcos ▸ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hji
        change x * i = j * x at hxi
        rw [← hconj] at hi
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := hi
        change v * k * v⁻¹ = i at hki
        refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
        calc
          (x * v) * k = (x * i) * v := by rw [← hki]; group
          _ = j * (x * v) := by rw [hxi]; group
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hi : v * k * v⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic I := by
          rw [← hconj]
          exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hxj : x * (v * k * v⁻¹) ∈
            (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
          hcos.symm ▸ ⟨v * k * v⁻¹, hi, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := hxj
        change j * x = x * (v * k * v⁻¹) at hjx
        refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
        calc
          j * (x * v) = (j * x) * v := by group
          _ = (x * (v * k * v⁻¹)) * v := by rw [hjx]
          _ = (x * v) * k := by group
    · apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
      intro k hk
      have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation v (Finsupp.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∈
          (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I :=
        hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
      have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation x (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)
      apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff (x * v) k).mp
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos
  constructor
  · intro I K x y hx hy
    have hxroot := label_roots x I.val hx
    have hyroot := label_roots y K.val hy
    refine ⟨⟨x⁻¹ * y, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change cs.geometricRepresentation (x⁻¹ * y) '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val
    calc
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation y '' piRoots K.val) := by
        simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I.val) := by rw [hyroot, hxroot]
      _ = piRoots I.val := by
        simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']
  · intro I K w x hx
    have hw : cs.geometricRepresentation w.val '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val := w.property
    have hc := root_conjugacy cs w.val K.val I.val hw
    have ht : label (x * w.val) K.val :=
      c_literal_label_preserved cs J I.val K.val x w.val hx.1 hx.2 hc hw
    refine ⟨ht, ⟨w.val, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    · change w.val = x⁻¹ * (x * w.val)
      simp only [inv_mul_cancel_left]
    · intro f hf
      exact Subtype.ext hf
```

```lean
noncomputable def UniversalWallGroupoid : ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) = Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs p.2 : Set W) ∧ CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs p.2 p.1 } :=
fun {S W} _inst {M} cs J => {
  Hom := fun A B => { w : W // w = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1 }
  id := fun A => ⟨1, (inv_mul_cancel A.val.1).symm⟩
  comp := fun {A B C} f g => ⟨f.val * g.val, by
    rw [f.property, g.property]
    simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]⟩
  id_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (one_mul f.val)
  comp_id := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_one f.val)
  assoc := fun f g h => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc f.val g.val h.val)
  inv := fun {A B} f => ⟨f.val⁻¹, by
    rw [f.property, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]⟩
  inv_comp := fun f => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel f.val)
  comp_inv := fun f => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel f.val)
}

abbrev accepted_ChamberMorphismCorrespondence_type : Prop :=
∀ {S W : Type*} [Finite S] [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
  let Obj := { I : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
      (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
    Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
      Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
    CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (x y : W), label x I.val → label y K.val →
    ∃ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K, f.val = x⁻¹ * y) ∧
  (∀ (I K : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (x : W) (hx : label x I.val),
    ∃ htarget : label (x * w.val) K.val,
      ∃! f : (UniversalWallGroupoid cs J).Hom
        ⟨(x, I.val), hx⟩ ⟨(x * w.val, K.val), htarget⟩,
        f.val = w.val)

universe u v
variable {S : Type u} {W : Type v} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
abbrev Obj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { I : Set S // ∃ g : W, (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J }
abbrev Label (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { p : W × Set S // Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.1) (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
    Set.image (fun u : W => p.1 * u) (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
    cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1 }
abbrev component (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (I : Set S) (a : S) :=
  { b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }
abbrev Atom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { e : Obj cs J × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component M e.1.val e.2)) }
abbrev Step (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { e : Label cs J × S // e.2 ∉ e.1.val.2 ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component M e.1.val.2 e.2)) }
noncomputable abbrev cross (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
noncomputable abbrev scross (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val.2 e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
abbrev composable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) (I K : Set S) :=
  List.foldr (fun e tail L => L = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (cross cs J e).2.1)
    (fun L => L = K) es I
noncomputable abbrev product (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :=
  (es.map (fun e => (cross cs J e).1)).prod
noncomputable abbrev weight (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :=
  (es.map (fun e => cs.length (cross cs J e).1)).sum
noncomputable abbrev path (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (p q : Label cs J) (es : List (Step cs J)) :=
  List.foldr (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧ tail ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1))
    (fun r => r = q.val) es p.val
noncomputable def canonical (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) :=
  Classical.choice (StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).1
noncomputable def d (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) : Nat :=
  (canonical cs J I K w).val.length

theorem standard_count (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (I K : Obj cs J) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K w) : e.val.length = d cs J I K w := by
  exact ((StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).2.2 e).trans
    ((StandardFactorCount cs J I K w).2.2 (canonical cs J I K w)).symm

noncomputable def toObj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (p : Label cs J) : Obj cs J :=
  ⟨p.val.2, ⟨p.val.1, by
    ext u
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      have hm : p.val.1 * v ∈ Set.image (fun u : W => p.val.1 * u)
          (cs.parabolic p.val.2 : Set W) := ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      rw [← p.property.1] at hm
      obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := hm
      have he' : p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ = z := by
        rw [← he, mul_inv_cancel_right]
      change p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic J
      rw [he']
      exact hz
    · intro hu
      have hm : u * p.val.1 ∈ Set.image (fun u : W => u * p.val.1)
          (cs.parabolic J : Set W) := ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      rw [p.property.1] at hm
      obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
      change p.val.1 * v * p.val.1⁻¹ = u
      change p.val.1 * v = u * p.val.1 at he
      rw [he, mul_inv_cancel_right]⟩⟩
noncomputable abbrev toAtom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) : Atom cs J :=
  ⟨(toObj cs J e.val.1, e.val.2), e.property⟩

theorem cross_toAtom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (e : Step cs J) :
    cross cs J (toAtom cs J e) = scross cs J e := rfl

abbrev Triangle (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (I K L : Obj cs J) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom K L),
    d cs J I L ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y) ≤ d cs J I K x + d cs J K L y ∧

      cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val)

theorem weight_bound (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) :
    cs.length (product cs J es) ≤ weight cs J es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp [product, weight]
  | cons e es ih =>
    change cs.length ((cross cs J e).1 * product cs J es) ≤
      cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + weight cs J es
    exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

theorem word_metric (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (ht : Triangle cs J) :

      (f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B),
      composable cs J es A.val B.val → product cs J es = f.val →
      d cs J A B f ≤ es.length ∧
      (d cs J A B f = es.length ↔ cs.length f.val = weight cs J es) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
    intro A B f hc hp
    let hstd : StandardExpressions cs J A B f :=
      ⟨[], hc, hp, by simpa only [product, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.sum_nil] using
        (congrArg cs.length hp).symm.trans (cs.length_one)⟩
    have hd : 0 = d cs J A B f := by
      simpa only [hstd, List.length_nil] using standard_count cs J A B f hstd
    have hf : f.val = 1 := hp.symm
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hd ⊢
    exact ⟨by omega, by simp [← hd, hf, weight]⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro A B f hc hp
    change A.val = e.val.1.val ∧ composable cs J es (cross cs J e).2.1 B.val at hc
    have hAe : A = e.val.1 := Subtype.ext hc.1
    subst A
    obtain ⟨htarget, x, hx⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J e.val.1.val
      e.val.1.property e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
    let T : Obj cs J := ⟨(cross cs J e).2.1, htarget⟩
    change (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom e.val.1 T at x
    change x.val = (cross cs J e).1 at hx
    let y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom T B :=
      (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x) f
    have hy : y.val = product cs J es := by
      change x.val⁻¹ * f.val = product cs J es
      change (cross cs J e).1 * product cs J es = f.val at hp
      rw [hx, ← hp, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    have hf : f.val = x.val * y.val := by
      change f.val = x.val * (x.val⁻¹ * f.val)
      simp
    have hcomp : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y = f := Subtype.ext hf.symm
    let hstd : StandardExpressions cs J e.val.1 T x :=
      ⟨[e], ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, by simpa only [product, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one] using hx.symm,
        by change cs.length x.val = cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + 0; rw [hx, add_zero]⟩
    have hxcount : d cs J e.val.1 T x = 1 := by
      simpa only [hstd, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] using
        (standard_count cs J _ _ x hstd).symm
    have htri := ht e.val.1 T B x y
    rw [hcomp, hxcount] at htri
    have hrec := ih T B y hc.2 hy.symm
    have hb := weight_bound cs J es
    have hm := cs.length_mul_le x.val y.val
    rw [← hy] at hb
    rw [← hf] at hm
    change d cs J e.val.1 B f ≤ es.length + 1 ∧
      (d cs J e.val.1 B f = es.length + 1 ↔
        cs.length f.val = cs.length (cross cs J e).1 + weight cs J es)
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro heq
      have htEq : d cs J e.val.1 B f = 1 + d cs J T B y := by omega
      have hyEq : d cs J T B y = es.length := by omega
      have hlen := htri.2.mp htEq
      rw [← hf, hx, hrec.2.mp hyEq] at hlen
      exact hlen
    · intro hlen
      have htail : cs.length y.val = weight cs J es := by rw [hx] at hm; omega
      have hxy : cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val := by
        rw [← hf, hx, htail]; exact hlen
      have htEq := htri.2.mpr hxy
      have hyEq := hrec.2.mpr htail
      omega
end GA

theorem path_word (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (p q : Label cs J) (es : List (Step cs J)) (hp : path cs J p q es) :
    composable cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) p.val.2 q.val.2 ∧
    product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = p.val.1⁻¹ * q.val.1 := by
  have aux : ∀ (es : List (Step cs J)) (r : W × Set S),
      List.foldr (fun e tail r => r = e.val.1.val ∧
        tail ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1)) (fun r => r = q.val) es r →
      composable cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) r.2 q.val.2 ∧
      r.1 * product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = q.val.1 := by
    intro es
    induction es with
    | nil =>
      intro r hr
      change r = q.val at hr
      subst r
      exact ⟨rfl, mul_one _⟩
    | cons e es ih =>
      intro r hr
      change r = e.val.1.val ∧ _ at hr
      obtain ⟨hc, hprod⟩ := ih ((scross cs J e).2.2 e.val.1.val.1) hr.2
      rw [hr.1]
      constructor
      · exact ⟨rfl, hc⟩
      · change e.val.1.val.1 * ((scross cs J e).1 *
          product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J))) = q.val.1
        change (e.val.1.val.1 * (scross cs J e).1) *
          product cs J (es.map (toAtom cs J)) = q.val.1 at hprod
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact hprod
  obtain ⟨hc, he⟩ := aux es p.val hp
  refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
  rw [← he, inv_mul_cancel_left]

-- Lifts a composable atom list with prescribed endpoints. Empty lists are included.
-- Local implementation helper for Proposition 3.29, pp.13--14; arrow preservation
-- is the explicitly quantified Proposition 4.6 premise, not an assumed theorem.
theorem lift_word [Finite S] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
    (cmc : accepted_ChamberMorphismCorrespondence_type.{u,v}) :
    ∀ (es : List (Atom cs J)) (A B : Obj cs J) (p q : Label cs J),
      p.val.2 = A.val → q.val.2 = B.val →
      p.val.1 * product cs J es = q.val.1 → composable cs J es A.val B.val →
      ∃ fs : List (Step cs J), path cs J p q fs ∧ fs.length = es.length := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
    intro A B p q hp hq he hc
    have hpq : p.val = q.val := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · simpa only [product, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, mul_one] using he
      · exact hp.trans (hc.trans hq.symm)
    exact ⟨[], hpq, rfl⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro A B p q hp hq he hc
    change A.val = e.val.1.val ∧ composable cs J es (cross cs J e).2.1 B.val at hc
    have hpe : p.val.2 = e.val.1.val := hp.trans hc.1
    obtain ⟨hT, x, hx⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J e.val.1.val e.val.1.property
      e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
    let T : Obj cs J := ⟨(cross cs J e).2.1, hT⟩
    change (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom e.val.1 T at x
    have hlabel := p.property
    rw [hpe] at hlabel
    obtain ⟨hr, _⟩ := (cmc (S := S) (W := W) (M := M) cs J).2 e.val.1 T x p.val.1 hlabel
    rw [hx] at hr
    let r : Label cs J := ⟨(p.val.1 * (cross cs J e).1, T.val), hr⟩
    have htail : r.val.1 * product cs J es = q.val.1 := by
      change (p.val.1 * (cross cs J e).1) * product cs J es = q.val.1
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact he
    obtain ⟨fs, hfs, hlen⟩ := ih T B r q rfl hq htail hc.2
    let s : Step cs J := ⟨(p, e.val.2), by simpa only [hpe] using e.property⟩
    have hcross : (scross cs J s).2.2 p.val.1 = r.val := by
      have hsource : toObj cs J p = e.val.1 := Subtype.ext hpe
      have ha : toAtom cs J s = e := by apply Subtype.ext; exact Prod.ext hsource rfl
      change (cross cs J (toAtom cs J s)).2.2 p.val.1 = r.val
      rw [ha]
      rfl
    refine ⟨s :: fs, ?_, by simpa only [List.length_cons, hlen]⟩
    change p.val = p.val ∧ _
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [hcross]
    exact hfs
```

```lean
import ArtinDeligne
import Proofs.BrinkHowlettGroupoid

noncomputable section
namespace RootClassTriangle
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
abbrev Objects := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map
  (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J }
def parallel (A : Objects cs J) (α : S →₀ ℝ) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {β | β ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ ∀ L, ∀ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L A,
    (0 < cs.geometricRepresentation f.val α ↔ 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation f.val β)}
def real (A : Objects cs J) (α : S →₀ ℝ) : Prop :=
  α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ ∃ L, ∃ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L A,
    ¬ (0 < α ↔ 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation f.val α)
def family (A : Objects cs J) (x : W) : Set (Set (S →₀ ℝ)) :=
  {c | (∃ α, real cs J A α ∧ c = parallel cs J A α) ∧
    c ⊆ ({α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α} ∩
      Set.image (cs.geometricRepresentation x) {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ α < 0})}
def inversion (x : W) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {α | α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ α < 0}
local notation "Obj" => Objects cs J
local notation "roots" => cs.geometricRoots
local notation "act" => cs.geometricRepresentation
local notation "parallelClass" => parallel cs J
local notation "realRoot" => real cs J
local notation "classes" => family cs J
local notation "N" => inversion cs

theorem image_N (x : W) : N x = {α | α ∈ roots ∧ 0 < α} ∩
    Set.image (act x) {α | α ∈ roots ∧ α < 0} := by
  ext α
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hr, hp⟩, act x⁻¹ α,
      ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).2 hr, hn⟩,
      Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hr, hp⟩, β, ⟨_, hn⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hr, hp, by simpa only [Representation.inv_self_apply] using hn⟩
-- Parallel-root-classes step 4.1: only finiteness is needed.
theorem finite_N (x : W) : Set.Finite (N x) := by
  induction hn : cs.length x using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with
  | ind n ih =>
    by_cases hx : x = 1
    · subst x
      have hz : N 1 = ∅ := by
        ext α
        simp only [inversion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, inv_one, map_one, one_apply_eq_self,
          Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨_, hp, hm⟩
        exact lt_asymm hp hm
      rw [hz]
      exact Set.finite_empty
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hx
    have hlen := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hi
    have hf := ih (cs.length (cs.simple i * x)) (by omega) (cs.simple i * x) rfl
    apply (hf.image (M.geometricReflection i)).insert (Finsupp.single i 1) |>.subset
    intro α hα
    by_cases heq : α = Finsupp.single i 1
    · exact Or.inl heq
    · refine Or.inr ⟨M.geometricReflection i α, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨(cs.geometricReflection_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff i).2 hα.1,
          cs.geometricReflection_pos_of_mem_geometricRoots hα.1 hα.2.1 heq, ?_⟩
        change cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * x)⁻¹
          (M.geometricReflection i α) < 0
        rw [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
          cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
        have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (M.geometricReflection_mul_self i) α
        change M.geometricReflection i (M.geometricReflection i α) = α at h
        rw [h]
        exact hα.2.2
      · have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (M.geometricReflection_mul_self i) α
        exact h
theorem hfinite (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B) :
    Set.Finite (classes A x.val) := by
  apply (finite_N cs x.val).powerset.subset
  intro c hc
  change c ⊆ N x.val
  rw [image_N cs]
  exact hc.2
theorem pc_self (A : Obj) {α : Finsupp S Real} (hr : α ∈ roots) :
    α ∈ parallelClass A α := ⟨hr, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩
-- Parallel-root-classes steps 1.1, 2.1: full class transport in both directions.
theorem pc_transport (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (α : Finsupp S Real) :
    Set.image (act x.val) (parallelClass B α) = parallelClass A (act x.val α) := by
  ext β
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).2 hγ.1, ?_⟩
    intro L f
    have h := hγ.2 L ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp f x)
    change (0 < act (f.val * x.val) α ↔ 0 < act (f.val * x.val) γ) at h
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp] using h
  · intro hβ
    refine ⟨act x.val⁻¹ β, ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).2 hβ.1, ?_⟩,
      Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩
    intro L f
    have h := hβ.2 L ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp f
      ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x))
    change (0 < act (f.val * x.val⁻¹) (act x.val α) ↔
      0 < act (f.val * x.val⁻¹) β) at h
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Representation.inv_self_apply] using h
-- Parallel-root-classes step 3.1: identity and inverse tests give saturation.
theorem saturated (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    {α : Finsupp S Real} (hα : α ∈ N x.val) : parallelClass A α ⊆ N x.val := by
  intro β hβ
  have hp := hβ.2 A ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).id A)
  have hn := hβ.2 B ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x)
  change (0 < act 1 α ↔ 0 < act 1 β) at hp
  simp only [map_one, one_apply_eq_self] at hp
  have hp' : 0 < β := hp.mp hα.2.1
  have hr := (cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x.val⁻¹).2 hβ.1
  refine ⟨hβ.1, hp', ?_⟩
  apply (cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr).resolve_left
  intro hb
  have ha : 0 < act x.val⁻¹ α := hn.mpr hb
  exact lt_asymm ha hα.2.2
theorem real_N (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    {α : Finsupp S Real} (hα : α ∈ N x.val) : realRoot A α := by
  refine ⟨hα.1, B, (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv x, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact lt_asymm (h.mp hα.2.1) hα.2.2
theorem classes_image (A B : Obj) (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B) :
    classes A x.val = Set.image (parallelClass A) (N x.val) := by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨α, hr, rfl⟩, hs⟩
    exact ⟨α, (image_N cs x.val).symm ▸ hs (pc_self cs J A hr.1), rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨α, real_N cs J A B x hα, rfl⟩, fun β hβ =>
      (image_N cs x.val) ▸ saturated cs J A B x hα hβ⟩


/- New internal implementation lemmas for the triangle inequality.
   Portal compressed-additivity, steps 1.1 and 2.1:
   https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-author-b19d43a8e520-bh-compressed-additivity
```
