```lean
theorem inverse_positive_of_transported (A B D : Obj)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D)
    {c : Set (S →₀ ℝ)} (hc : c ∈ Set.image (Set.image (act x.val)) (classes B y.val))
    {α : S →₀ ℝ} (hα : α ∈ c) : 0 < act x.val⁻¹ α := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩ := hα
  have hp : 0 < β := (hd.2 hβ).1.2
  simpa only [Representation.inv_self_apply] using hp

theorem family_containment (A B D : Obj)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D) :
    classes A (x.val * y.val) ⊆
      classes A x.val ∪ Set.image (Set.image (act x.val)) (classes B y.val) := by
  let z := (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y
  have hz : z.val = x.val * y.val := rfl
  rw [← hz, classes_image cs J A D z, hz]
  rintro c ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩
  have hr := (cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x.val⁻¹).2 hα.1
  rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
  · right
    let β := act x.val⁻¹ α
    have hβ : β ∈ N y.val := by
      refine ⟨hr, hp, ?_⟩
      have hh := hα.2.2
      simpa only [mul_inv_rev, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp] using hh
    refine ⟨parallelClass B β, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [classes_image cs J B D y]
      exact ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [β, Representation.self_inv_apply] using pc_transport cs J A B x β
  · left
    rw [classes_image cs J A B x]
    exact ⟨α, ⟨hα.1, hα.2.1, hn⟩, rfl⟩

theorem family_disjoint (A B D : Obj)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D) :
    Disjoint (classes A x.val)
      (Set.image (Set.image (act x.val)) (classes B y.val)) := by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro c hc ht
  rw [classes_image cs J A B x] at hc
  obtain ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ := hc
  have hp := inverse_positive_of_transported cs J A B D x y ht (pc_self cs J A hα.1)
  exact lt_asymm hp hα.2.2

    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D)

    exact lt_asymm hp hα.1.2.2

    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)

    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D) :
    (classes A x.val ∪ Set.image (Set.image (act x.val)) (classes B y.val)).ncard =

    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D) :
    (classes A (x.val * y.val)).ncard ≤
      (classes A x.val).ncard + (classes B y.val).ncard := by
  rw [← comparison_card cs J A B D x y]

    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D)

    (classes A (x.val * y.val)).ncard <
      (classes A x.val).ncard + (classes B y.val).ncard := by

    have hh : act (x * y)⁻¹ (-act x β) = -act y⁻¹ β := by
      simp [map_neg, Representation.inv_self_apply, mul_inv_rev, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]
    rw [hh] at h
    exact lt_asymm (neg_pos.mpr hβ.2.2) h
  constructor
  · ext α
    constructor
    · intro hα
      have hr := (cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x⁻¹).2 hα.1
      rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
      · right
        refine ⟨act x⁻¹ α, ⟨hr, hp, ?_⟩, Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩

    · rintro (hα | ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩)
      · exact hprefix hα
      · refine ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).2 hβ.1,
          pos_transport hβ, ?_⟩

    rw [hh] at h
    exact lt_asymm hβ.2.1 h

theorem family_union_of_add (A B D : Obj)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D)
    (hl : cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val) :
    classes A (x.val * y.val) =
      classes A x.val ∪ Set.image (Set.image (act x.val)) (classes B y.val) := by
  let z := (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp x y
  have hz : z.val = x.val * y.val := rfl
  have hc := classes_image cs J A D z
  rw [hz] at hc
  rw [hc, classes_image cs J A B x, classes_image cs J B D y]
  change parallelClass A '' N (x.val * y.val) = _
  rw [(reduced cs x.val y.val hl).1, Set.image_union]
  congr 1
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α, ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨parallelClass B β, ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩, pc_transport cs J A B x β⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨act x.val β, ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩, (pc_transport cs J A B x β).symm⟩

theorem card_eq_iff_add (A B D : Obj)
    (x : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom A B)
    (y : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom B D) :
    (classes A (x.val * y.val)).ncard =
      (classes A x.val).ncard + (classes B y.val).ncard ↔
    cs.length (x.val * y.val) = cs.length x.val + cs.length y.val := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    by_contra hn
    exact (card_strict_of_not_add cs J A B D x y hn).ne he
  · intro hl
    rw [family_union_of_add cs J A B D x y hl]
    exact comparison_card cs J A B D x y

end RootClassTriangle
```

```lean
namespace ChamberMorphismTransport
noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
def root (i : S) : S →₀ ℝ := Finsupp.single i 1
def piRoots (I : Set S) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) := root '' I
def label (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (x : W) (I : Set S) : Prop :=
  (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
    (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) ∧ cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)
theorem coset_conj (x : W) (I : Set S)
    (h : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W)) :
    (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J := by
  classical
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, huv⟩
    change x * u * x⁻¹ = v at huv
    have hm : x * u ∈ (fun t : W => t * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
      h.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun t : W => x * t) hu
    obtain ⟨t, ht, he⟩ := hm
    have hev : t = v := by rw [← huv, ← he]; group
    exact hev ▸ ht
  · intro hv
    have hm : v * x ∈ (fun t : W => x * t) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) :=
      h ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun t : W => t * x) hv
    obtain ⟨t, ht, he⟩ := hm
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    change x * t = v * x at he
    change x * t * x⁻¹ = v
    rw [he]
    group
/- Portal Proposition 4.6 step 1.1 uses the simple-root transport of each label.
   Reuse the completed FiniteWallPaths implementation: minimal parabolic
   transporters conjugate simple generators; root positivity selects the
   positive simple root. All imported hypotheses are explicit below. -/
theorem transporter_root (x : W) (I F : Set S)
    (hc : (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F)
    (hm : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x) {i : S} (hi : i ∈ I) :
    ∃ j ∈ F, cs.geometricRepresentation x (root i) = root j := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_conjugates_simple cs hc hm hi
  let v := cs.geometricRepresentation x (root i)
  have hneg : M.geometricReflection j v = -v := by
    have hprod : cs.simple j * x = x * cs.simple i := by rw [← he]; group
    calc
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple j * x) (root i) := by
        rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
      _ = -v := by
        rw [hprod]
        exact cs.geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_single x i
  have hr : v ∈ cs.geometricRoots := ⟨x, i, rfl⟩
  have hpos : 0 < v := (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr
    (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hm i hi)
  have hs : ∀ k, k ≠ j → v k = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hh := congrArg (fun z : S →₀ ℝ => z k) hneg
    rw [M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hk] at hh
    change v k = -v k at hh
    linarith
  rcases cs.eq_single_or_eq_neg_single_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hs with hh | hh
  · exact ⟨j, hj, hh⟩
  · have hn : v j = -1 := by rw [hh]; simp
    have hp := hpos.le j
    change 0 ≤ v j at hp
    linarith
theorem label_roots (x : W) (I : Set S) (hx : label cs J x I) :
    cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I = piRoots J := by
  classical
  have hc := coset_conj cs J x I hx.1
  have hci := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hc
  have hmi := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter cs hc hx.2
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := transporter_root cs x I J hc hx.2 hi
    exact ⟨j, hj, he.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := transporter_root cs x⁻¹ J I hci hmi hj
    refine ⟨root i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← he, Representation.self_inv_apply]
end
end ChamberMorphismTransport


noncomputable def BrinkHowlettGroupoid : (∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }) :=
(by
  intro S W inst M cs J
  let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
    fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
  exact {
    Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
      Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
    id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
    comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
        _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
    id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
    comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
    assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
    inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=
                  congrArg (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)) x.property.symm
        _ = roots K.val := by
          simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
    inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
    comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
  })

theorem first_conjunct : ∀ {S W : Type*} [Finite S] [Group W]
    {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
    let Obj := { I : Set S // ∃ g : W,
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
        (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
    let label : W → Set S → Prop := fun x I =>
      Set.image (fun u : W => u * x) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J : Set W) =
        Set.image (fun u : W => x * u) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I : Set W) ∧
      CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep cs I x
    ∀ (I K : Obj) (x y : W), label x I.val → label y K.val →
      ∃ f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K, f.val = x⁻¹ * y := by
  intro S W finiteS groupW M cs J
  classical
  dsimp only
  intro I K x y hx hy
  have hp := label_roots cs J x I.val hx
  have hq := label_roots cs J y K.val hy
  have hi : cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ '' piRoots J = piRoots I.val := by
    rw [← hp, Set.image_image]
    simp only [Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']
  refine ⟨⟨x⁻¹ * y, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  change cs.geometricRepresentation (x⁻¹ * y) '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val
  calc
    _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
        (cs.geometricRepresentation y '' piRoots K.val) := by
          simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
    _ = _ := by rw [hq, hi]
end
end ChamberMorphismTransport
```

```lean
example {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I D : Set S)
    (wD : cs.parabolic D) (wJ : cs.parabolic (D ∩ I))
    (opD : D ≃ D) (opJ : ↥(D ∩ I) ≃ ↥(D ∩ I))
    (hD : ∀ i : D, cs.geometricRepresentation (wD : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) 1) =
      -Finsupp.single (opD i : S) 1)
    (hJ : ∀ i : ↥(D ∩ I), cs.geometricRepresentation (wJ : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) 1) =
      -Finsupp.single (opJ i : S) 1) :
    let r : W := (wD : W) * (wJ : W)
    let KD : Set S := (fun i : D => (opD i : S)) '' {i : D | (i : S) ∈ I}
    r ∈ cs.parabolic D ∧ KD ⊆ D ∧
      cs.geometricRepresentation r '' ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' (D ∩ I)) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' KD := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨mul_mem wD.property (cs.parabolic_mono Set.inter_subset_left wJ.property), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro k ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact (opD i).property
  · ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      let j : ↥(D ∩ I) := ⟨i, hi⟩
      let k : D := ⟨(opJ j : S), (opJ j).property.1⟩
      refine ⟨(opD k : S), ⟨k, (opJ j).property.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hJ j, map_neg, hD k, neg_neg]
    · rintro ⟨k, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      let jI : ↥(D ∩ I) := ⟨(j : S), j.property, hj⟩
      let i := opJ.symm jI
      refine ⟨Finsupp.single (i : S) 1, ⟨(i : S), i.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hJ i, map_neg]
      have he : (opJ i : S) = (j : S) := congrArg Subtype.val (opJ.apply_symm_apply jI)
      rw [he, hD j, neg_neg]

-- Reflection equivariance and parabolic conjugacy, without assuming conjugacy.
example {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
    (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
  classical
  let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
  let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
      g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
    apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
      calc
        _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
          (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
    dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
    simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
  have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]
```

Argument: write E=Θ_J and let b be the supplied orthonormal basis indexed by a finite type ι, with d=card ι=dim E. For a retained root α use the existing retainedEvaluation M J ⟨α,hα⟩, rather than constructing a functional from a quotient. Its value at f is definitionally f.val α. Retention supplies a nonzero evaluation witness, so this functional is nonzero and its kernel is proper. Existing retainedRoots_iff also certifies properness.

For x in its kernel meeting B_E(u,ε/d), put h=u−x, a_i=a(b_i), and A=max_i |a_i|. Nonzero a and the basis expansion give A>0 and a nonempty index type. Each coordinate satisfies |h_i|<ε/d by the squared-coordinate ball inequality. Therefore |a(u)|=|Σ_i h_i a_i|≤Σ_i |h_i a_i|<Σ_i (ε/d)A=εA. Choose i attaining A. Then a(u+εb_i)a(u−εb_i)=a(u)^2−ε^2a_i^2<0. Both endpoint evaluations are strictly nonzero. The checked declarations coordinate_separation, basis_separation and orthonormal_separation establish this argument; root_basis_separation specializes it to the actual retained root evaluation. The orthonormal wrapper uses Parseval and takes dist x u<ε/card ι.

The checked radius_bounds establishes 0<ε/card ι≤ε when ε>0 and ι is nonempty. The upper bound uses card ι≥1, not merely positivity of an arbitrary real denominator. Thus the smaller ball lies in the supplied ε-ball. For d=0, do not divide by d: finite-dimensionality gives Subsingleton E, and checked restrictedArrangement_empty_of_subsingleton proves that the full retained arrangement is empty. This also covers empty S and J=S.

For counting, use ambient kernels H_α=(Module.Dual.eval ℝ (Vector S) α).ker and trace H=H.comap (relativeSubspace J).subtype. Checked restriction_kernel_eq identifies this trace definitionally with restrictedHyperplane J α. Agreement of ambient and restricted evaluations is likewise definitional, so the very same α strictly separates the ambient vertex pair.

Checked finite_restricted_kernels_meeting packages the counting argument. Its explicit inputs are a finite basis, ε>0, a set B satisfying the basis-coordinate squared-ball bound, and finiteness of the ambient kernel sets strictly separating each opposite vertex pair. Its conclusion is Set.Finite {K | K ∈ restrictedArrangement M J ∧ (B ∩ K).Nonempty}. It applies finite_image_cover to the finite union of ambient separating sets and the comap trace map. No injectivity of the trace map is assumed: coincident traces are counted once as submodules. This conclusion covers all retained roots; the translation's positive-retained-root arrangement is a subset, so Set.Finite.subset gives its required conclusion.

```lean
import Proofs.FiniteRelativeLongest
import Lean
open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Recover a helper's actual proof, closing all its local dependencies. -/
private partial def recoverLocal (target : Name) (e : Expr)
    (xs : Array Expr := #[]) : MetaM Expr := do
  match e with
  | .lam n t b bi =>
      withLocalDecl n bi t fun x => recoverLocal target (b.instantiate1 x) (xs.push x)
  | .letE n t v b _ =>
      if n == target then
        mkLambdaFVars xs v (usedOnly := true)
      else
        withLetDecl n t v fun x => recoverLocal target (b.instantiate1 x) (xs.push x)
  | .mdata _ b => recoverLocal target b xs
  | _ => throwError "Local helper {target} was not found in the current proof"

elab "recoverFRL% " n:ident : term => do
  let ci ← getConstInfo ``FiniteRelativeLongest
  let c ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``FiniteRelativeLongest
  let some v := ci.value? (allowOpaque := true) | throwError "FiniteRelativeLongest has no available proof body"
  recoverLocal n.getId (v.instantiateLevelParams ci.levelParams c.constLevels!)

namespace BHExistenceRecovery
noncomputable def outside := recoverFRL% outside
noncomputable def sphericalSupport := recoverFRL% finiteRootDifferenceSphericalSupport
noncomputable def opposition := recoverFRL% oppositionWork
noncomputable def positiveOutside := recoverFRL% positiveOutside
noncomputable def relativeLongest := recoverFRL% SphericalSupportRelativeLongest
end BHExistenceRecovery

namespace BHExistenceRecovery
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}

def parabolicRoots (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {x | ∃ w ∈ cs.parabolic I, ∃ i ∈ I,
    cs.geometricRepresentation w (Finsupp.single i 1) = x}

noncomputable def simpleRoots (I : Set S) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I

def Supported (I : Set S) (x : S →₀ ℝ) : Prop := ∀ k, k ∉ I → x k = 0

theorem parabolic_supported (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S)
    {x : S →₀ ℝ} (hx : x ∈ parabolicRoots cs I) : Supported I x := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, i, hi, rfl⟩ := hx
  intro k hk
  rw [outside cs I w hw k hk]
  simp [show i ≠ k from fun h => hk (h ▸ hi)]

-- This finite-support expansion has no ambient rank hypothesis.
theorem action_coordinate (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (w : W) (x : S →₀ ℝ) (k : S) :
    cs.geometricRepresentation w x k =
      ∑ i ∈ x.support, x i * cs.geometricRepresentation w (Finsupp.single i 1) k := by
  classical
  have he : x = ∑ i ∈ x.support, x i • Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ) := by
    ext j
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  conv_lhs => rw [he, map_sum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply', map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

theorem nonneg_action (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (w : W) (I : Set S)
    (hcol : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ cs.geometricRepresentation w (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hs : Supported I x) :
    0 ≤ cs.geometricRepresentation w x := by
  classical
  intro k
  rw [action_coordinate]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  have hiI : i ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hs i hn)
  exact mul_nonneg (hx i) (hcol i hiI k)

theorem supported_action (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (w : W) (I K : Set S)
    (hcol : ∀ i ∈ I, Supported K (cs.geometricRepresentation w (Finsupp.single i 1)))
    (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hs : Supported I x) : Supported K (cs.geometricRepresentation w x) := by
  classical
  intro k hk
  rw [action_coordinate]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  have hiI : i ∈ I := by
    by_contra hn
    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hs i hn)
  rw [hcol i hiI k hk, mul_zero]

theorem positive_supported_root_mem_parabolic (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S)
    (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hx : x ∈ cs.geometricRoots) (hp : 0 < x) (hs : Supported I x) :
    x ∈ parabolicRoots cs I := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨u, i, hu⟩ := hx
  let y := cs.simple i * u⁻¹
  have hy : cs.geometricRepresentation y x = -Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    rw [← hu]
    dsimp only [y]
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Representation.inv_self_apply,
      cs.geometricRepresentation_simple, M.geometricReflection_apply_single_self]
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hd⟩ := cs.exists_isMinimalCosetRep I y
  let z := cs.geometricRepresentation v⁻¹ x
  have hz : 0 < z := positiveOutside cs I v⁻¹ ((cs.parabolic I).inv_mem hv) x
    ⟨u, i, hu⟩ hp hn
  have hzs : Supported I z := by
    intro k hk
    exact (outside cs I v⁻¹ ((cs.parabolic I).inv_mem hv) k hk x).trans (hs k hk)
  have hcol : ∀ j ∈ I, 0 ≤ cs.geometricRepresentation (y * v) (Finsupp.single j 1) := by
    intro j hj
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff (y * v) j).mpr ?_ |>.le
    intro hdes
    exact (hd (cs.simple j) (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hj)).not_gt hdes
  have hnonneg := nonneg_action cs (y * v) I hcol z hz.le hzs
  have he : cs.geometricRepresentation (y * v) z = -Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Representation.self_inv_apply, hy]
  rw [he] at hnonneg
  have hbad := hnonneg i
  norm_num at hbad



theorem singleton_relative_sign (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I K : Set S) (w : W)
    (htransport : cs.geometricRepresentation w '' simpleRoots K = simpleRoots I)
    (a : S) (ha : a ∉ I)
    (hdes : cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ (Finsupp.single a 1) < 0)
    (x : S →₀ ℝ) (hx : x ∈ parabolicRoots cs (Set.insert a I))
    (hp : 0 < x) (hn : x ∉ parabolicRoots cs I) :
    cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ x < 0 := by
  classical
  let root : S → S →₀ ℝ := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
  have basis (i : S) (hi : i ∈ I) : ∃ j ∈ K, act w⁻¹ (root i) = root j := by
    have hm : root i ∈ act w '' simpleRoots K := htransport.symm ▸ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
    refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
    rw [← he, Representation.inv_self_apply]
  have invcol : ∀ i ∈ I, Supported K (act w⁻¹ (root i)) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := basis i hi
    rw [he]
    intro k hk
    simp [root, show j ≠ k from fun h => hk (h ▸ hj)]
  let z := act w⁻¹ (root a)
  have hznot : ¬ Supported K z := by
    intro hs
    have col : ∀ j ∈ K, Supported I (act w (root j)) := by
      intro j hj
      have hm : act w (root j) ∈ simpleRoots I :=
        htransport ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (act w) ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := hm
      rw [← he]
      intro k hk
      simp [show i ≠ k from fun h => hk (h ▸ hi)]
    have hh := supported_action cs w K I col z hs
    have he : act w z = root a := Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _
    rw [he] at hh
    have hb := hh a ha
```

A direct route to that specialization avoids both a full elementary inversion formula and any identification of real roots with relative roots. First, parabolic words preserve coordinates outside their generating set. For α∈N(v), positivity of α and negativity of v⁻¹α therefore force every coordinate outside D to vanish. If α_a=0, α is a nonnegative finite combination of Π_I. Because v⁻¹Π_I=Π_K, its image would be nonnegative, contradicting v⁻¹α<0. Hence every α∈N(v) is supported on D⊆I∪{a} and has strictly positive a-coordinate.

Second, fix any article arrow f:L→I, so fΠ_I=Π_L. The ambient root q=fα_a has a nonzero coordinate outside L: otherwise applying f⁻¹ to its finite expansion in Π_L would put α_a in span(Π_I), impossible since a∉I. For α as above, outside L the coordinates of fα equal α_a times those of q. Since α_a>0 and both fα and q are ambient roots, ambient root sign uniformity forces their signs to agree. This proves the required uniformity for every outgoing root-action arrow, including arrows unrelated to the finite component. The span assertion here follows from transport of simple-root sets and finite-support expansion; it does not require the converse parabolic-root support recognition theorem.

Finally, prove the seed α_a∈N(v). The root eα_a has a-coordinate 1, is supported on D, and is therefore positive. Opposition for d sends every nonnegative vector supported on D to a nonpositive vector. Thus d(eα_a)=v⁻¹α_a is nonpositive and nonzero, hence negative. This establishes the seed. The remaining Lean work is to formalize these support, finite-sum and sign arguments and feed their two conclusions into singleton_of_uniform_signs. These are proposed local implementation helpers, not standalone article results.

```lean
noncomputable def BrinkHowlettGroupoid : (∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }) :=
(by
  intro S W inst M cs J
  let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
    fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
  exact {
    Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
      Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
    id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
    comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
        _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
    id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
    comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
    assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
    inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=

          simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
    inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
    comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
```

```lean
import ArtinDeligne

namespace FiniteWallPathsHelper2

theorem root_conjugacy {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
    (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
  classical
  let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
  let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
      g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
    apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
      calc
        _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
          (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
    dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
    simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
  have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]

end FiniteWallPathsHelper2

#print axioms FiniteWallPathsHelper2.root_conjugacy
```

```lean
import ArtinDeligne

/- Local implementation block, no original standalone theorem is claimed.
Parent: Lemma 3.20(3) and Remark 3.22, printed p.11.
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=11
Numbered inspiration: portal step 2.1:
https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-lem-finite-wall-path-artin-tits-normalisers
This algebraic block proves that a lifted crossing retains the label predicate
once conjugacy and simple-root transport have been supplied. It does not
establish those premises for an arbitrary element v or prove path connectivity.
No rank or spherical-type assumption is used.
-/
universe uS uW

theorem c_literal_label_preserved {S : Type uS} {W : Type uW} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I K : Set S) (x v : W)
    (hcos : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W))
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x)
    (hconj : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic I)
    (hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation v ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' K) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I) :
    (fun u : W => u * (x * v)) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u : W => (x * v) * u) '' (cs.parabolic K : Set W) ∧
    cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K (x * v) := by
  constructor
  · ext r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      have hji : j * x ∈ (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) := hcos ▸ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hji
      change x * i = j * x at hxi
      rw [← hconj] at hi
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := hi
      change v * k * v⁻¹ = i at hki
      refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
      calc
        (x * v) * k = (x * i) * v := by rw [← hki]; group
        _ = j * (x * v) := by rw [hxi]; group
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hi : v * k * v⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic I := by
        rw [← hconj]
        exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hxj : x * (v * k * v⁻¹) ∈
          (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
        hcos.symm ▸ ⟨v * k * v⁻¹, hi, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := hxj
      change j * x = x * (v * k * v⁻¹) at hjx
      refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
      calc
        j * (x * v) = (j * x) * v := by group
        _ = (x * (v * k * v⁻¹)) * v := by rw [hjx]
        _ = (x * v) * k := by group
  · apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation v (Finsupp.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∈
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I :=
      hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
    have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation x (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) :=
      (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff (x * v) k).mp
    simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos

```

```lean
def CommonPrefixFinite {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) : Prop :=
  let Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J}

    {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen

    {α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic L ∧ ∃ i ∈ L,
      cs.geometricRepresentation u (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) = α}

    ∀ (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component I.val a)))
```

```lean
abbrev Obj (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g))
    (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J }

def component (L : Set S) (a : S) : Set S :=
  { b | b ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b }

abbrev Atom (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  { p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧ Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) p.1.val p.2)) }

noncomputable def crossing (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (t : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs t.val.1.val t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2

noncomputable def word (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) : W :=
  (es.map (fun t => (crossing cs J t).1)).prod

noncomputable def weight (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (es : List (Atom cs J)) : Nat :=
  (es.map (fun t => cs.length (crossing cs J t).1)).sum
```

```lean
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}
    let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
    let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
    let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
      ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
    ∃ action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label,
      (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
        let y := action (quotientMap g) p
        y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧ cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
        ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) ∧
      (∀ p q : Label, (∃ g : N, action g p = q) ↔ p.val.2 = q.val.2) ∧
      (∀ (g : N) (p : Label), action g p = p → g = 1) := by
  classical
  let W := M.Group
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  let Label := {p : W × Set S //
      (fun u => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let H := (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk' H
  have coset_iff_conj (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
      (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
      Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext z
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
          ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
        rw [← h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
        simpa [this] using hu
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
          change x * u = z * x at he
          calc
            x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
            _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
            _ = u := by group
        simpa [this] using hu
    · intro h
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        change u ∈ P at hu
        rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
        exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

  have conj_product (P : Subgroup W) (x y : W) :
      P.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom =
        (P.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun f : W →* W => P.map f)
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    change (x*y)*z*(x*y)⁻¹ = x*(y*z*y⁻¹)*x⁻¹
    group

  let A : Norm →* Equiv.Perm Label := by
    have htrans (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
        (cs.parabolic p.val.2).map (MulAut.conj (g.val * p.val.1)).toMonoidHom =
          cs.parabolic J := by
      rw [conj_product, (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1]
      rw [MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe]
      simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using
        Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp g.property
    let act : Norm → Label → Label := fun g p =>
      ⟨(cs.minimalCosetRep p.val.2 (g.val * p.val.1), p.val.2),
        (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mpr
          (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimalCosetRep_transports_parabolic cs (htrans g p)),
        cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _⟩
    have act_spec (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
        ∃ u, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ (act g p).val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u := by
      refine ⟨(g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ * (act g p).val.1,
        cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem _ _, ?_⟩
      group
    have act_one (p : Label) : act 1 p = p := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) p.property.2
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec 1 p
      change (act 1 p).val.1⁻¹ * p.val.1 ∈ _
      rw [he]
      simpa only [Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc,
        inv_mul_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu
    have act_mul (g h : Norm) (p : Label) : act (g * h) p = act g (act h p) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec (g*h) p
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hf⟩ := act_spec h p
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hk⟩ := act_spec g (act h p)
      change (act (g*h) p).val.1⁻¹ * (act g (act h p)).val.1 ∈ _
      rw [he, hk, hf]
      have hh : ((g*h).val*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ *
          (g.val*(h.val*p.val.1*v)*t) = u⁻¹*v*t := by
        change ((g.val*h.val)*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ * _ = _
        group
      rw [hh]
      exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem
        ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu) hv) ht
    exact {
      toFun := fun g => {
        toFun := act g
        invFun := act g⁻¹
        left_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, inv_mul_cancel, act_one]
        right_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, mul_inv_cancel, act_one] }
      map_one' := by apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_one p
      map_mul' := by intro g h; apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_mul g h p }

  have A_snd (g : Norm) (p : Label) : (A g p).val.2 = p.val.2 := rfl
  have A_min (g : Norm) (p : Label) : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.val.2 (A g p).val.1 :=
    cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _
  have A_spec (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
      ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ (A g p).val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u := by
    refine ⟨(g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ * (A g p).val.1,
      cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem _ _, ?_⟩
    group
  have parabolic_kernel : H ≤ A.ker := by
    intro g hg
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro p
    change A g p = p
    apply Subtype.ext
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (A_snd g p)
    have hgJ : g.val ∈ cs.parabolic J := by
      change g.val ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J at hg
      simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using hg
    have hp := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1
    rw [← hp, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hgJ
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
    apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs (A_min g p) p.property.2
    rw [he]
    have heq : (g.val * p.val.1 * u)⁻¹ * p.val.1 =
        u⁻¹ * (p.val.1⁻¹ * g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [heq]
    exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem
      ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu) ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hgJ)
  let action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label := QuotientGroup.lift H A parabolic_kernel
  have action_mk (g : Norm) : action (quotientMap g) = A g := rfl
  refine ⟨action, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g p
    change (action (quotientMap g) p).val.2 = p.val.2 ∧ _
    rw [action_mk]
    exact ⟨A_snd g p, A_min g p, A_spec g p⟩
  · intro p q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H g
      change action (quotientMap g) p = q at hg
      rw [action_mk] at hg
      exact (A_snd g p).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z : Label => z.val.2) hg)
    · intro hpq
      have hp := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1
      have hq := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp q.property.1
      have hinv : (cs.parabolic J).map (MulAut.conj p.val.1⁻¹).toMonoidHom =
          cs.parabolic p.val.2 := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hp
      have hg : q.val.1 * p.val.1⁻¹ ∈
          Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W) := by
        apply Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mpr
        rw [← MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, conj_product, hinv, hpq, hq]
      let g : Norm := ⟨q.val.1 * p.val.1⁻¹, by
        change _ ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J : Set W)
        rw [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq]
        exact hg⟩
      refine ⟨quotientMap g, ?_⟩
      rw [action_mk]
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ((A_snd g p).trans hpq)
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (A_min g p) (by simpa only [hpq] using q.property.2)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
      rw [he]
      have heq : (g.val * p.val.1 * u)⁻¹ * q.val.1 = u⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [g]
        group
      rw [heq]
      exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu
  · intro g p hg
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H g
    change action (quotientMap g) p = p at hg
    rw [action_mk] at hg
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
    have hf : (A g p).val.1 = p.val.1 := congrArg (fun z : Label => z.val.1) hg
    have heq : g.val = p.val.1 * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by
      rw [hf] at he
      calc
        g.val = (g.val * p.val.1 * u) * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by group
        _ = p.val.1 * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by rw [← he]
    have hgJ : g.val ∈ cs.parabolic J := by
      rw [← (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1, heq]
      exact ⟨u⁻¹, (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu, rfl⟩
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mpr
    change g.val ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J
    simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using hgJ

have coset_iff_conj {W : Type _} [Group W] (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
    (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
    Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext z
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
        ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
      rw [← h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
      simpa [this] using hu
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
        change x * u = z * x at he
        calc
          x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
          _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
          _ = u := by group
      simpa [this] using hu
  · intro h
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      change u ∈ P at hu
      rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
      exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
      rw [← h]
      exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

have root_conjugacy {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
    (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
      ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
    (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
  classical
  let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
  let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
  have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
      g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
    apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
      calc
        _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
          (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
    dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
    simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
  have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
  simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]

let Obj {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  {I : Set S // ∃ g : W, (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J}

let Label {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) :=
  {p : W × Set S // (fun u : W => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
    (fun u : W => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧ cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}

have label_root_iff {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S) (x : W) (I : Set S) :
    ((fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x) ↔
    cs.geometricRepresentation x '' ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' I) =
      (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) '' J := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let A : Obj cs J := ⟨J, 1, by
      ext u
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
      simp⟩
    let B : Obj cs J := ⟨I, x, (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp hx.1⟩
    have hone : (fun u : W => u * 1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => 1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) ∧
        cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J 1 := ⟨by simp, cs.isMinimalCosetRep_one J⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (algebraicCorrespondence cs J).1 A B 1 x hone hx
    have hr := w.property
    rw [hw] at hr
    simpa only [inv_one, one_mul] using hr
  · intro hr
    refine ⟨(coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mpr (root_conjugacy cs x I J hr), ?_⟩
    apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
    intro i hi
    have hm : cs.geometricRepresentation x (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) ∈
        (fun j : S => Finsupp.single j (1 : Real)) '' J :=
      hr ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single i 1, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := hm
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mp
    rw [← hj]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one) (by
      intro h
      have hh := congrArg (fun v : S →₀ Real => v j) h
      norm_num at hh)

/- Local implementation of Theorem 4.7, printed pp.16–17 (Theorem 1.3, p.2).
No standalone article statement is attributed to this helper.
https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers
Portal steps 1.1, 2.2 and 3.2 inspire simple-system transport and the
quotient action. Step 5.1 inspires identification of the full deck group.
Departure: instead of using the abstract quotient-cover theorem or a
normaliser splitting, prove the full carrier by the base label (1,J),
minimal-coset uniqueness and the already constructed concrete action.
All statements in this block have arbitrary rank and Coxeter type. -/
have strictDeck {S : Type _} (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
    let L := Label cs J
    let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
    let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
    let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
      ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
    let a := Classical.choose (algebraicAction M J)
    (∀ (n : N) (A : L), (a n A).val.2 = A.val.2) ∧
    (∀ (n : N) (A B : L),
      (a n A).val.1⁻¹ * (a n B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1) ∧
    ∃ deck : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm L),
      (∀ σ : Equiv.Perm L, σ ∈ deck ↔
        (∀ A : L, (σ A).val.2 = A.val.2) ∧
        (∀ A B : L, (σ A).val.1⁻¹ * (σ B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1)) ∧
      ∃ e : N ≃* deck,
        (∀ n : N, (e n).val = a n) ∧
        (∀ (n : N) (A : L), (e n).val A = A → n = 1) ∧
        (∀ (g : Norm) (A : L), ∃ u : M.Group,
          u ∈ cs.parabolic A.val.2 ∧
          ((e (quotientMap g)).val A).val.1 = g.val * A.val.1 * u) ∧
        (∀ A B : L, A.val.2 = B.val.2 ↔ ∃ n : N, (e n).val A = B) := by
  classical
  let W := M.Group
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  let L := Label cs J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let H := (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk' H
  let a := Classical.choose (algebraicAction M J)
  have ha := Classical.choose_spec (algebraicAction M J)
  let A0 : L := ⟨(1, J), by simp, cs.isMinimalCosetRep_one J⟩
  have snd (n : N) (A : L) : (a n A).val.2 = A.val.2 := by
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H n
    exact (ha.1 g A).1
  -- Portal 1.1 and 2.2: positive simple-system transport composes literally.
  have left_label (d : W) (hd : Label cs J) (hcoord : hd.val = (d, J))
      (A : L) :
      (fun u : W => u * (d * A.val.1)) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => (d * A.val.1) * u) '' (cs.parabolic A.val.2 : Set W) ∧
        cs.IsMinimalCosetRep A.val.2 (d * A.val.1) := by
    apply (label_root_iff cs J _ _).mpr
    have hdroot := (label_root_iff cs J hd.val.1 hd.val.2).mp hd.property
    rw [hcoord] at hdroot
    have hAroot := (label_root_iff cs J A.val.1 A.val.2).mp A.property
    calc
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation d ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation A.val.1 ''
            ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' A.val.2)) := by
              simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
      _ = _ := by rw [hAroot]; exact hdroot
  have left_formula (n : N) (A : L) :
      (a n A).val.1 = (a n A0).val.1 * A.val.1 := by
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H n
    let d := (a (quotientMap g) A0).val.1
    have hlabel := left_label d (a (quotientMap g) A0)
      (Prod.ext rfl (snd _ A0)) A
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := (ha.1 g A0).2.2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hf⟩ := (ha.1 g A).2.2
    have huJ : u ∈ cs.parabolic J := hu
    have hm : u * A.val.1 ∈
        (fun t : W => A.val.1 * t) '' (cs.parabolic A.val.2 : Set W) :=
      A.property.1 ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem (fun t : W => t * A.val.1) huJ
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := hm
    apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs (ha.1 g A).2.1 hlabel.2
    change (a (quotientMap g) A).val.1⁻¹ * (d * A.val.1) ∈ _
    rw [hf]
    have hd : d = g.val * u := by
      change d = g.val * 1 * u at he
      simpa only [mul_one] using he
    rw [hd]
    have heq : (g.val * A.val.1 * v)⁻¹ * ((g.val * u) * A.val.1) = v⁻¹ * t := by
      change A.val.1 * t = u * A.val.1 at hte
      calc
        _ = (g.val * A.val.1 * v)⁻¹ * (g.val * (u * A.val.1)) := by group
        _ = (g.val * A.val.1 * v)⁻¹ * (g.val * (A.val.1 * t)) := by rw [hte]
        _ = _ := by group
    rw [heq]
    exact (cs.parabolic A.val.2).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic A.val.2).inv_mem hv) ht
  have disp (n : N) (A B : L) :
      (a n A).val.1⁻¹ * (a n B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1 := by
    rw [left_formula n A, left_formula n B]
    group
  -- Portal 5.1: a strict deck permutation is determined by its value at A0.
  have full (σ : Equiv.Perm L)
      (hs : ∀ A : L, (σ A).val.2 = A.val.2)
      (hd : ∀ A B : L, (σ A).val.1⁻¹ * (σ B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1) :
      ∃ n : N, a n = σ := by
    let d := (σ A0).val.1
    have hc := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp (σ A0).property.1
    rw [hs A0] at hc
    let g : Norm := ⟨d, by
      apply Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mpr
      simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq,
        ← MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe] using hc⟩
    have hbase : a (quotientMap g) A0 = σ A0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ((snd _ A0).trans (hs A0).symm)
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs (ha.1 g A0).2.1
        (by simpa only [hs A0] using (σ A0).property.2)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := (ha.1 g A0).2.2
      rw [he]
      change (d * 1 * u)⁻¹ * d ∈ cs.parabolic J
      simpa only [mul_one, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left,
        inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using (cs.parabolic J).inv_mem hu
    refine ⟨quotientMap g, ?_⟩
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro A
    apply Subtype.ext
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ((snd _ A).trans (hs A).symm)
    rw [left_formula, congrArg (fun z : L => z.val.1) hbase]
    have ht := hd A0 A
    change d⁻¹ * (σ A).val.1 = 1⁻¹ * A.val.1 at ht
    calc
      d * A.val.1 = d * (d⁻¹ * (σ A).val.1) := by simpa only [inv_one, one_mul] using congrArg (fun z : W => d * z) ht.symm
      _ = _ := by group
  let deck : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm L) := a.range
  have carrier (σ : Equiv.Perm L) : σ ∈ deck ↔
      (∀ A : L, (σ A).val.2 = A.val.2) ∧
      (∀ A B : L, (σ A).val.1⁻¹ * (σ B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨snd n, disp n⟩
    · rintro ⟨hs, hd⟩
      exact full σ hs hd
  have inj : Function.Injective a := by
    intro n m h
    have hfix : a (m⁻¹ * n) A0 = A0 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, h]
      exact (a m).symm_apply_apply A0
    have he := ha.2.2 (m⁻¹ * n) A0 hfix
    have : n = m := by
      calc
        n = m * (m⁻¹ * n) := by group
        _ = m := by rw [he, mul_one]
    exact this
  let e : N ≃* deck := MulEquiv.ofBijective a.rangeRestrict
    ⟨fun n m h => inj (congrArg Subtype.val h), a.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  have he (n : N) : (e n).val = a n := rfl
  refine ⟨snd, disp, deck, carrier, e, he, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n A hfix
    exact ha.2.2 n A hfix
  · intro g A
    exact (ha.1 g A).2.2
  · intro A B
    exact (ha.2.1 A B).symm
```

```lean
have quotientFibres
    (a : N →* Equiv.Perm (Label))
    (a_snd : ∀ (n : N) (A : Label), (a n A).val.2 = A.val.2)
    (a_disp : ∀ (n : N) (A B : Label),
      (a n A).val.1⁻¹ * (a n B).val.1 = A.val.1⁻¹ * B.val.1)
    (a_orbit : ∀ A B : Label,
      (∃ n : N, a n A = B) ↔ A.val.2 = B.val.2) :
    (∀ A B : Label,
      F.obj A = F.obj B ↔
        ∃ n : N, a n A = B) ∧
    (let UpstairsArrow := Σ A : Label, Σ B : Label,
        (UniversalWallGroupoid cs J).Hom A B
     let BaseArrow := Σ I : Obj, Σ K : Obj,
        (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K
     let arrowMap : UpstairsArrow → BaseArrow := fun p =>
       ⟨F.obj p.1, F.obj p.2.1,
         F.map p.2.2⟩
     Function.Surjective arrowMap ∧
     ∀ p q : UpstairsArrow,
       arrowMap p = arrowMap q ↔
         ∃ n : N, a n p.1 = q.1 ∧ a n p.2.1 = q.2.1) := by
  let UpstairsArrow := Σ A : Label, Σ B : Label,
    (UniversalWallGroupoid cs J).Hom A B
  let BaseArrow := Σ I : Obj, Σ K : Obj,
    (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K
  let arrowMap : UpstairsArrow → BaseArrow := fun p =>
    ⟨F.obj p.1, F.obj p.2.1,
      F.map p.2.2⟩
  /- Local implementation of Theorem 4.7 (printed pp.16–17), also Theorem 1.3
     (printed p.2), not an original standalone article statement.
     https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.21915#page=16
     https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/item-thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers
     Portal steps 3.1 and 4.2 inspire the lifting and quotient-fibre arguments.
     Proof-method detail: total arrows remain dependent Sigma triples. Equality
     is proved by transporting both endpoint equalities before subtype
     extensionality; equality of group labels alone is never substituted for
     equality of total arrows. No rank, sphericality or topology premise. -/
  have baseArrow_ext (p q : BaseArrow)
      (hs : p.1 = q.1) (ht : p.2.1 = q.2.1)
      (hv : p.2.2.val = q.2.2.val) : p = q := by
    rcases p with ⟨I, K, f⟩
    rcases q with ⟨I', K', g⟩
    dsimp only at hs ht hv
    cases hs
    cases ht
    have hf : f = g := Subtype.ext hv
    cases hf
    rfl

  have arrowMap_eq_iff (p q : UpstairsArrow) :
      arrowMap p = arrowMap q ↔
        p.1.val.2 = q.1.val.2 ∧ p.2.1.val.2 = q.2.1.val.2 ∧
        p.1.val.1⁻¹ * p.2.1.val.1 = q.1.val.1⁻¹ * q.2.1.val.1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hs := congrArg (fun r : BaseArrow => r.1.val) h
      have ht := congrArg (fun r : BaseArrow => r.2.1.val) h
      have hv := congrArg (fun r : BaseArrow => r.2.2.val) h
      change p.2.2.val = q.2.2.val at hv
      rw [p.2.2.property, q.2.2.property] at hv
      exact ⟨hs, ht, hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨hs, ht, hv⟩
      apply baseArrow_ext
      · exact Subtype.ext hs
      · exact Subtype.ext ht
      · change p.2.2.val = q.2.2.val
        rw [p.2.2.property, q.2.2.property]
        exact hv

  /- Portal step 3.1: lift the source object and then the complete outgoing
     arrow. The equality of outgoing Sigma pairs is retained by congrArg. -/
  have arrowMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (arrowMap) := by
    rintro ⟨I, K, w⟩
    obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := hFsurj I
    obtain ⟨⟨B, f⟩, hf⟩ := (hFcover A).2 ⟨K, w⟩
    refine ⟨⟨A, B, f⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun r : ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.Outgoing (Obj)
      (F.obj A) =>
        (⟨F.obj A, r.1, r.2⟩ : BaseArrow)) hf

  constructor
  · intro A B
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply (a_orbit A B).mpr
      exact congrArg (fun I : Obj => I.val) h
    · intro h
      exact Subtype.ext ((a_orbit A B).mp h)
  constructor
  · exact arrowMap_surjective
  · intro p q
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨hs, ht, hd⟩ := (arrowMap_eq_iff p q).mp h
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (a_orbit p.1 q.1).mpr hs
      refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · have hh := a_disp n p.1 p.2.1
        rw [hn] at hh
        exact mul_left_cancel (hh.trans hd)
      · exact (a_snd n p.2.1).trans ht
    · rintro ⟨n, hs, ht⟩
      apply (arrowMap_eq_iff p q).mpr
      refine ⟨(a_snd n p.1).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun A : Label => A.val.2) hs),
        (a_snd n p.2.1).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun A : Label => A.val.2) ht), ?_⟩
      have hh := a_disp n p.1 p.2.1
      have hsx := congrArg (fun A : Label => A.val.1) hs
      have htx := congrArg (fun A : Label => A.val.1) ht
      rw [hsx, htx] at hh
      exact hh.symm
```

```lean
      have hprod : cs.simple j * x = x * cs.simple i := by rw [← he]; group
      calc
        _ = cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple j * x) (root i) := by
          rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
        _ = -v := by
          rw [hprod, cs.geometricRepresentation_mul_simple_single]
    have hr : v ∈ cs.geometricRoots := ⟨x, i, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 < v := (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr
      (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hm i hi)
    have hs : ∀ k, k ≠ j → v k = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have hh := congrArg (fun z : S →₀ ℝ => z k) hneg
      rw [M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hk] at hh
      change v k = -v k at hh
      linarith
    rcases cs.eq_single_or_eq_neg_single_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hs with hh | hh
    · exact ⟨j, hj, hh⟩
    · have hn : v j = -1 := by rw [hh]; simp
      have hp := hpos.le j
      change 0 ≤ v j at hp
      linarith
  have label_roots (x : W) (I : Set S) (hx : label x I) :
      cs.geometricRepresentation x '' piRoots I = piRoots J := by
    have hc := coset_conj x I hx.1
    have hci := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hc
    have hmi := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter cs hc hx.2
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := transporter_root x I J hc hx.2 hi
      exact ⟨j, hj, he.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := transporter_root x⁻¹ J I hci hmi hj
      refine ⟨root i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [← he, Representation.self_inv_apply]

  have root_conjugacy (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (g : W) (L F : Set S)
      (ht : cs.geometricRepresentation g ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' L) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' F) :
      (cs.parabolic L).map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic F := by
    classical
    let act := cs.geometricRepresentation
    let root : S → (S →₀ ℝ) := fun i => Finsupp.single i 1
    have reflect (g : W) (i k : S) (h : act g (root i) = root k) :
        g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹ = cs.simple k := by
      apply cs.geometricRepresentation_injective
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      have form : M.geometricForm (root i) (act g⁻¹ x) = M.geometricForm (root k) x := by
        calc
          _ = M.geometricForm (act g (root i)) (act g (act g⁻¹ x)) :=
            (cs.geometricForm_geometricRepresentation g (root i) (act g⁻¹ x)).symm
          _ = _ := by rw [h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
      change act (g * cs.simple i * g⁻¹) x = act (cs.simple k) x
      dsimp only [act, root] at h form ⊢
      simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
        M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [form, h, Representation.self_inv_apply]
    have genImage : (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom '' (cs.simple '' L) = cs.simple '' F := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        have hm : act g (root i) ∈ root '' F := ht ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
        obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨k, hk, (reflect g i k he.symm).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hm : root k ∈ act g '' (root '' L) := ht.symm ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hk
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, he⟩ := hm
        exact ⟨cs.simple i, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, reflect g i k he⟩
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, genImage]

  have c_literal_label_preserved {S W : Type _} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I K : Set S) (x v : W)
      (hcos : (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W))
      (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep I x)
      (hconj : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic I)
      (hroots : cs.geometricRepresentation v ''
        ((fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' K) =
        (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I) :
      (fun u : W => u * (x * v)) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
        (fun u : W => (x * v) * u) '' (cs.parabolic K : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K (x * v) := by
    constructor
    · ext r
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have hji : j * x ∈ (fun u : W => x * u) '' (cs.parabolic I : Set W) := hcos ▸ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hji
        change x * i = j * x at hxi
        rw [← hconj] at hi
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hki⟩ := hi
        change v * k * v⁻¹ = i at hki
        refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
        calc
          (x * v) * k = (x * i) * v := by rw [← hki]; group
          _ = j * (x * v) := by rw [hxi]; group
      · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hi : v * k * v⁻¹ ∈ cs.parabolic I := by
          rw [← hconj]
          exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
        have hxj : x * (v * k * v⁻¹) ∈
            (fun u : W => u * x) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) :=
          hcos.symm ▸ ⟨v * k * v⁻¹, hi, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx⟩ := hxj
        change j * x = x * (v * k * v⁻¹) at hjx
        refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
        calc
          j * (x * v) = (j * x) * v := by group
          _ = (x * (v * k * v⁻¹)) * v := by rw [hjx]
          _ = (x * v) * k := by group
    · apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
      intro k hk
      have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation v (Finsupp.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∈
          (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) '' I :=
        hroots ▸ ⟨Finsupp.single k 1, ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := hr
      have hpos : 0 < cs.geometricRepresentation x (Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) :=
        (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff x i).mpr (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)
      apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff (x * v) k).mp
      simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ← heq] using hpos
  constructor
  · -- Portal step 1.1: apply the inverse action to the two root-set equalities.
    intro I K x y hx hy
    have hp := label_roots x I.val hx
    have hq := label_roots y K.val hy
    have hi : cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ '' piRoots J = piRoots I.val := by
      rw [← hp, Set.image_image]
      simp only [Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']
    refine ⟨⟨x⁻¹ * y, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change cs.geometricRepresentation (x⁻¹ * y) '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val
    calc
      _ = cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ ''
          (cs.geometricRepresentation y '' piRoots K.val) := by
            simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
      _ = _ := by rw [hq, hi]
  · intro I K w x hx
    have hr : cs.geometricRepresentation w.val '' piRoots K.val = piRoots I.val :=
      w.property
    /- Portal step 1.2: reflection equivariance and faithfulness give the
       parabolic conjugacy, then literal coset transport.
       Steps 1.3 and 2.1: the implementation uses the equivalent simple-root
       right-descent criterion directly, avoiding the unnecessary expansion
       of all positive parabolic roots. This is a proof-method departure only.
       Literature: the defect report finding pdf-prop46-left-descent-typo
       (https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/artin-tits-normalisers-2509-21915/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects)
       identifies the printed proof's right/left descent typo, replacing
       ℓ(ys_j)<ℓ(y) by ℓ(s_jy)<ℓ(y). It does not refute Proposition 4.6.
       We use the checked minimal-transporter and right-descent APIs instead. -/
    have hc := root_conjugacy cs w.val K.val I.val hr
    have ht : label (x * w.val) K.val :=
      c_literal_label_preserved cs J I.val K.val x w.val hx.1 hx.2 hc hr
    refine ⟨ht, ⟨⟨w.val, ?_⟩, rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    · change w.val = x⁻¹ * (x * w.val)
      simp only [inv_mul_cancel_left]
    · intro f hf
      exact Subtype.ext hf
)

/- Local implementation of Theorem 4.7, printed pp.16–17; no standalone
article statement is attributed to this helper. Portal covering steps 2.2/3.2
inspire the quotient action; we reuse the completed Lemma 3.24 algebraic
implementation by canonical minima, whose proof uses no rank assumption.
The accepted main endpoint retains finite rank only in its geometric clause. -/
theorem algebraicAction {S : Type*} (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (J : Set S) :
    let W := M.Group
    let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
    let Label := {p : W × Set S //
      (fun u => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}
    let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
    let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
    let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk'
      ((ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm)
    ∃ action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label,
      (∀ (g : Norm) (p : Label),
        let y := action (quotientMap g) p
        y.val.2 = p.val.2 ∧ cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.val.2 y.val.1 ∧
        ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ y.val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u) ∧
      (∀ p q : Label, (∃ g : N, action g p = q) ↔ p.val.2 = q.val.2) ∧
      (∀ (g : N) (p : Label), action g p = p → g = 1) := by
  classical
  let W := M.Group
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  let Label := {p : W × Set S //
      (fun u => u * p.1) '' (cs.parabolic J : Set W) =
      (fun u => p.1 * u) '' (cs.parabolic p.2 : Set W) ∧
      cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.2 p.1}
  let Norm := ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.CoxeterNormalizer M J
  let N := ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J
  let H := (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf Norm
  let quotientMap : Norm → N := QuotientGroup.mk' H
  have coset_iff_conj (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
      (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
      Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext z
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
      constructor
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
          ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
        rw [← h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
        simpa [this] using hu
      · intro hz
        have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [h] at ht
        obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
        have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
          change x * u = z * x at he
          calc
            x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
            _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
            _ = u := by group
        simpa [this] using hu
    · intro h
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        change u ∈ P at hu
        rw [← h, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hu
        exact ⟨x⁻¹ * u * x, hu, by group⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x * u * x⁻¹, ?_, by group⟩
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

  have conj_product (P : Subgroup W) (x y : W) :
      P.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom =
        (P.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun f : W →* W => P.map f)
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    change (x*y)*z*(x*y)⁻¹ = x*(y*z*y⁻¹)*x⁻¹
    group

  let A : Norm →* Equiv.Perm Label := by
    have htrans (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
        (cs.parabolic p.val.2).map (MulAut.conj (g.val * p.val.1)).toMonoidHom =
          cs.parabolic J := by
      rw [conj_product, (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1]
      rw [MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe]
      simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using
        Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp g.property
    let act : Norm → Label → Label := fun g p =>
      ⟨(cs.minimalCosetRep p.val.2 (g.val * p.val.1), p.val.2),
        (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mpr
          (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimalCosetRep_transports_parabolic cs (htrans g p)),
        cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _⟩
    have act_spec (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
        ∃ u, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ (act g p).val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u := by
      refine ⟨(g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ * (act g p).val.1,
        cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem _ _, ?_⟩
      group
    have act_one (p : Label) : act 1 p = p := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) p.property.2
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec 1 p
      change (act 1 p).val.1⁻¹ * p.val.1 ∈ _
      rw [he]
      simpa only [Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc,
        inv_mul_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu
    have act_mul (g h : Norm) (p : Label) : act (g * h) p = act g (act h p) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _) (cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := act_spec (g*h) p
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hf⟩ := act_spec h p
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hk⟩ := act_spec g (act h p)
      change (act (g*h) p).val.1⁻¹ * (act g (act h p)).val.1 ∈ _
      rw [he, hk, hf]
      have hh : ((g*h).val*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ *
          (g.val*(h.val*p.val.1*v)*t) = u⁻¹*v*t := by
        change ((g.val*h.val)*p.val.1*u)⁻¹ * _ = _
        group
      rw [hh]
      exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem
        ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu) hv) ht
    exact {
      toFun := fun g => {
        toFun := act g
        invFun := act g⁻¹
        left_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, inv_mul_cancel, act_one]
        right_inv := fun p => by rw [← act_mul, mul_inv_cancel, act_one] }
      map_one' := by apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_one p
      map_mul' := by intro g h; apply Equiv.ext; intro p; exact act_mul g h p }

  have A_snd (g : Norm) (p : Label) : (A g p).val.2 = p.val.2 := rfl
  have A_min (g : Norm) (p : Label) : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep p.val.2 (A g p).val.1 :=
    cs.isMinimalCosetRep_minimalCosetRep _ _
  have A_spec (g : Norm) (p : Label) :
      ∃ u : W, u ∈ cs.parabolic p.val.2 ∧ (A g p).val.1 = g.val * p.val.1 * u := by
    refine ⟨(g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ * (A g p).val.1,
      cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem _ _, ?_⟩
    group
  have parabolic_kernel : H ≤ A.ker := by
    intro g hg
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro p
    change A g p = p
    apply Subtype.ext
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (A_snd g p)
    have hgJ : g.val ∈ cs.parabolic J := by
      change g.val ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J at hg
      simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using hg
    have hp := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1
    rw [← hp, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hgJ
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
    apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs (A_min g p) p.property.2
    rw [he]
    have heq : (g.val * p.val.1 * u)⁻¹ * p.val.1 =
        u⁻¹ * (p.val.1⁻¹ * g.val * p.val.1)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [heq]
    exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).mul_mem
      ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu) ((cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hgJ)
  let action : N →* Equiv.Perm Label := QuotientGroup.lift H A parabolic_kernel
  have action_mk (g : Norm) : action (quotientMap g) = A g := rfl
  refine ⟨action, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g p
    change (action (quotientMap g) p).val.2 = p.val.2 ∧ _
    rw [action_mk]
    exact ⟨A_snd g p, A_min g p, A_spec g p⟩
  · intro p q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H g
      change action (quotientMap g) p = q at hg
      rw [action_mk] at hg
      exact (A_snd g p).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z : Label => z.val.2) hg)
    · intro hpq
      have hp := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1
      have hq := (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp q.property.1
      have hinv : (cs.parabolic J).map (MulAut.conj p.val.1⁻¹).toMonoidHom =
          cs.parabolic p.val.2 := ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.inverse_parabolic_transporter cs hp
      have hg : q.val.1 * p.val.1⁻¹ ∈
          Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W) := by
        apply Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mpr
        rw [← MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, conj_product, hinv, hpq, hq]
      let g : Norm := ⟨q.val.1 * p.val.1⁻¹, by
        change _ ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J : Set W)
        rw [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq]
        exact hg⟩
      refine ⟨quotientMap g, ?_⟩
      rw [action_mk]
      apply Subtype.ext
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ((A_snd g p).trans hpq)
      apply CoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep.eq_of_inv_mul_mem cs
        (A_min g p) (by simpa only [hpq] using q.property.2)
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
      rw [he]
      have heq : (g.val * p.val.1 * u)⁻¹ * q.val.1 = u⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [g]
        group
      rw [heq]
      exact (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu
  · intro g p hg
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective H g
    change action (quotientMap g) p = p at hg
    rw [action_mk] at hg
    obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := A_spec g p
    have hf : (A g p).val.1 = p.val.1 := congrArg (fun z : Label => z.val.1) hg
    have heq : g.val = p.val.1 * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by
      rw [hf] at he
      calc
        g.val = (g.val * p.val.1 * u) * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by group
        _ = p.val.1 * u⁻¹ * p.val.1⁻¹ := by rw [← he]
    have hgJ : g.val ∈ cs.parabolic J := by
      rw [← (coset_iff_conj _ _ _).mp p.property.1, heq]
      exact ⟨u⁻¹, (cs.parabolic p.val.2).inv_mem hu, rfl⟩
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mpr
    change g.val ∈ ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic M J
    simpa only [ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using hgJ
theorem coset_iff_conj {W : Type*} [Group W] (P Q : Subgroup W) (x : W) :
    (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) = (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) ↔
    Q.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom = P := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext z
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => x * u) '' (Q : Set W) :=
        ⟨x⁻¹ * z * x, hz, by group⟩
      rw [← h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : u = z := mul_right_cancel he
      simpa [this] using hu
    · intro hz
      have ht : z * x ∈ (fun u => u * x) '' (P : Set W) := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := ht
      have : x⁻¹ * z * x = u := by
        change x * u = z * x at he
        calc
          x⁻¹ * z * x = x⁻¹ * (z * x) := by group
          _ = x⁻¹ * (x * u) := by rw [← he]
          _ = u := by group
      simpa [this] using hu
  · intro h
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
```
